' Radar x, y: each object (scene0 .. nobj - 1) with a scanner colour (obj word 7's high byte) as
' a dot on the scanner round x, y: across vwx / 1024, up the screen vwz / 1024 (from ViewAll)
' (NEW: with the build's "ground" feature, / 512 both ways: -22 .. 22 across, -18 .. 18 up)   ' <--- NEW
Public Sub Radar(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (rd_cx), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (rd_cy), a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld a, ({scene0})
            ld b, a
            ld a, ({nobj})
            sub b
            jr z, rd_end
            jr c, rd_end
            ld c, a                 ; how many
            ld l, b
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld (rd_o), hl
rd_lp:
            push bc
            ld hl, (rd_o)
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld de, {obj} + 15
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)              ; the scanner colour
            or a
            jr z, rd_nx
            ld (rd_c), a
            ld hl, (rd_o)
            ld de, {vwz}
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld a, d                 ; <--- NEW (ground: z / 512, -18 .. 18 - a nearer, bigger scanner)
            sra a                   ; <--- NEW
            cp 19                   ; <--- NEW
            jp p, rd_out            ; <--- NEW
            cp -18                  ; <--- NEW
            jp m, rd_out            ; <--- NEW
            neg
            ld hl, rd_cy
            add a, (hl)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            push de
            ld hl, (rd_o)
            ld bc, {vwx}
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld a, d                 ; <--- NEW (ground: x / 512, -22 .. 22)
            sra a                   ; <--- NEW
            pop de                  ; <--- NEW
            cp 23                   ; <--- NEW
            jp p, rd_nx             ; <--- NEW
            cp -22                  ; <--- NEW
            jp m, rd_nx             ; <--- NEW
            ld hl, rd_cx
            add a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld a, (rd_c)
            call fn_e3_lib_dot
            jr rd_nx
rd_out:
rd_nx:
            ld hl, (rd_o)
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld (rd_o), hl
            pop bc
            dec c
            jr nz, rd_lp
rd_end:
            ld sp, ({sps})
            jr rd_e
rd_cx:      db 0
rd_cy:      db 0
rd_c:       db 0
rd_o:       dw 0
rd_e:
#endasm
End Sub

' Skyline tab, n, yb: (NEW) mountains on the skyline of a level camera (a ground game's: Fly3D.Drive   ' <--- NEW (to its End Sub)
' keeps it level, so the horizon is row yb, 96). The Integer array at tab (VarPtr) holds n peaks of
' 6 words: the peak's bearing in the world (x, z: 127 is 1 - far off: it never comes nearer), its
' half width and height in pixels as seen head on, its colours (as pc), its top (0: a point; k: flat,
' w / 2^k each side of the middle). Each one ahead is a triangle (or a flat topped cone) standing
' on row yb + 1, in the order given: draw the far ones first. Its place across is the bearing seen
' by the camera's right and forward; its size shrinks toward the edges as the projection's does
Public Sub Skyline(ByVal tab As Integer, ByVal n As Integer, ByVal yb As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (sk_p), de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (sk_n), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (sk_yb), a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            ld a, (sk_n)
            or a
            jp z, sk_end
sk_lp:
            ld ix, (sk_p)
            ld de, ({cm} + 12)      ; f: how far ahead (bearing . forward; 127 dead ahead)
            ld bc, ({cm} + 16)
            call sk_dot
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp nz, sk_nx            ; (behind)
            ld a, l
            cp 24
            jp c, sk_nx             ; (too far round to the side)
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, fn_e3data_redge_redge_d
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (sk_r), hl           ; R = 65536 / f
            ld de, ({cm} + 0)       ; X: across (bearing . right)
            ld bc, ({cm} + 4)
            call sk_dot
            ld a, h
            ld (sk_sg), a
            bit 7, h
            jr z, sk_xp
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
sk_xp:
            add hl, hl              ; |X| x 128 x R >> 16: the pixels across from the middle
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, (sk_r)
            call fn_e3_lib_umul
            ld a, (sk_sg)
            bit 7, a
            jr z, sk_x2
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
sk_x2:
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            ld (sk_x), hl
            ld a, (ix + 4)          ; the half width and the height, x 127 / f
            call sk_sc
            ld (sk_w), hl
            ld a, (ix + 6)
            call sk_sc
            ld (sk_h), hl
            ld hl, (sk_x)           ; on the screen at all? (x + w >= 0, x - w < 256)
            ld de, (sk_w)
            add hl, de
            ld (sk_rx), hl
            bit 7, h
            jp nz, sk_nx
            ld hl, (sk_x)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sk_lx), hl
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, sk_in
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp nz, sk_nx
sk_in:
            ld a, (sk_yb)           ; the corners: (x - w, yb + 1), the top, (x + w, yb + 1)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            inc hl
            ld (sk_yf), hl
            ld a, (sk_yb)
            ld l, a
            ld de, (sk_h)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (sk_yt), hl
            ld hl, (sk_lx)
            ld ({pvx}), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yf)
            ld ({pvy}), hl
            ld a, (ix + 10)         ; flat topped?
            or a
            jr nz, sk_flat
            ld hl, (sk_x)
            ld ({pvx} + 2), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yt)
            ld ({pvy} + 2), hl
            ld hl, (sk_rx)
            ld ({pvx} + 4), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yf)
            ld ({pvy} + 4), hl
            ld a, 3
            jr sk_fill
sk_flat:
            ld b, a
            ld hl, (sk_w)
sk_tw:
            srl h
            rr l
            djnz sk_tw
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (sk_x)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld ({pvx} + 2), hl
            ld hl, (sk_x)
            add hl, de
            ld ({pvx} + 4), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yt)
            ld ({pvy} + 2), hl
            ld ({pvy} + 4), hl
            ld hl, (sk_rx)
            ld ({pvx} + 6), hl
            ld hl, (sk_yf)
            ld ({pvy} + 6), hl
            ld a, 4
sk_fill:
            ld ({pn}), a
            xor a
            ld ({pn} + 1), a
            ld l, (ix + 8)
            ld h, (ix + 9)
            ld ({pc}), hl
            call fn_e3_lib_fill
sk_nx:
            ld hl, (sk_p)
            ld de, 12
            add hl, de
            ld (sk_p), hl
            ld hl, sk_n
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, sk_lp
            jr sk_end
; sk_dot: HL = (bearing x . DE + bearing z . BC) >> 14 (the record at IX)
sk_dot:
            push bc
            ld c, (ix + 0)
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            call fn_e3_lib_m14
            pop de
            push hl
            ld c, (ix + 2)
            ld b, (ix + 3)
            call fn_e3_lib_m14
            pop de
            add hl, de
            ret
; sk_sc: HL = A x 127 x R >> 16
sk_sc:
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, (sk_r)
            jp fn_e3_lib_umul
sk_p:       dw 0
sk_n:       db 0
sk_yb:      db 0
sk_sg:      db 0
sk_r:       dw 0
sk_x:       dw 0
sk_w:       dw 0
sk_h:       dw 0
sk_lx:      dw 0
sk_rx:      dw 0
sk_yf:      dw 0
sk_yt:      dw 0
sk_end:
            pop iy
            ld ix, ({six})
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' HPlane ux, uy, uz, c: (NEW) the screen where (x - 128) ux + (96 - y) uy + 128 uz < 0 filled in
' the colours c (ux, uy, uz: -64 .. 64): the ground under the horizon, u being "up" in the view
Public Sub HPlane(ByVal ux As Integer, ByVal uy As Integer, ByVal uz As Integer, ByVal c As Integer, ByVal yb As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (hp_ux), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (hp_uy), a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (hp_uz), de
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({pc}), de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (hp_xy + 10), a
            ld (hp_xy + 14), a
            ld (hp_yb), a
            ld b, a
            ld a, 96
            sub b
            ld (hp_q + 5), a
            ld (hp_q + 7), a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld hl, (hp_uz)          ; uz x 128
            ld b, 7
hp_z7:
            add hl, hl
            djnz hp_z7
            ld (hp_uz), hl
            ld ix, hp_q             ; the corners' f
            ld iy, hp_f
            ld b, 4
hp_fl:
            push bc
            ld d, (ix + 0)
            ld a, (hp_ux)
            ld e, a
            call fn_e3_lib_mul8s
            push de
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            ld a, (hp_uy)
            ld e, a
            call fn_e3_lib_mul8s
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, (hp_uz)
            add hl, de
            ld (iy + 0), l
            ld (iy + 1), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc iy
            inc iy
            pop bc
            djnz hp_fl
            xor a                   ; round the corners, cut where f changes sign
            ld (hp_n), a
            ld (hp_j), a
hp_cl:
            ld a, (hp_j)
            call hp_getf            ; HL = f(j)
            ld (hp_a), hl
            ld a, (hp_j)
            inc a
            and 3
            call hp_getf
            ld (hp_b), hl
            ld a, (hp_a + 1)        ; f(j) < 0: the corner's in
            bit 7, a
            jr z, hp_c1
            ld a, (hp_j)
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, hp_xy
            add hl, de
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            call hp_put
hp_c1:
            ld a, (hp_a + 1)        ; the signs differ: where the edge crosses
            ld b, a
            ld a, (hp_b + 1)
            xor b
            jp p, hp_c2
            ld hl, (hp_a)
            bit 7, h
            call nz, hp_neg
            push hl
            ld hl, (hp_b)
            bit 7, h
            call nz, hp_neg
            pop de
            add hl, de              ; |fa| + |fb|
            ex de, hl               ; HL = |fa|, DE = the sum
            call fn_e3_lib_udivf    ; t (x 65536)
            ld (hp_t), hl
            ld a, (hp_j)
            or a
            jr nz, hp_e1
            ld de, 254              ; top: x = 1 + 254 t, y 0
            call hp_kt
            inc hl
            ex de, hl
            ld bc, 0
            jr hp_ep
hp_e1:
            cp 1
            jr nz, hp_e2
            ld a, (hp_yb)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            call hp_kt
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, 255
            jr hp_ep
hp_e2:
            cp 2
            jr nz, hp_e3
            ld de, 254              ; bottom: x = 255 - 254 t, y 192
            call hp_kt
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 255
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hp_yb)
            ld c, a
            ld b, 0
            jr hp_ep
hp_e3:
            ld a, (hp_yb)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            call hp_kt
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hp_yb)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, 1
hp_ep:
            call hp_put
hp_c2:
            ld a, (hp_j)
            inc a
            ld (hp_j), a
            cp 4
            jp c, hp_cl
            ld a, (hp_n)
            cp 3
            jr c, hp_end
            ld ({pn}), a
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            call fn_e3_lib_fill
            pop iy
            ld ix, ({six})
            jr hp_end
hp_getf:    ; HL = f(A)
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, hp_f
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ret
hp_neg:
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
            ret
hp_kt:      ; HL = DE x t / 65536
            ld bc, (hp_t)
            call fn_e3_lib_umul
            ret
hp_put:     ; a point: x DE, y BC
            ld a, (hp_n)
            add a, a
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            push hl
            push bc
            ld bc, {pvx}
            add hl, bc
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            pop bc
            pop hl
            ld de, {pvy}
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), c
            inc hl
            ld (hl), b
            ld hl, hp_n
            inc (hl)
            ret
hp_q:       db -127, 96, 127, 96, 127, -96, -127, -96
hp_xy:      dw 1, 0, 255, 0, 255, 192, 1, 192
hp_f:       ds 8
hp_ux:      db 0
hp_uy:      db 0
hp_uz:      dw 0
hp_yb:      db 192
hp_n:       db 0
hp_j:       db 0
hp_a:       dw 0
hp_b:       dw 0
hp_t:       dw 0
hp_end:
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' Box x, y, w, h, c: (NEW) a filled rectangle in colour c (the HUD's bars and frames)
Public Sub Box(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({pvx}), de
            ld ({pvx} + 6), de
            ex de, hl
            ld (bx_x), hl
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({pvy}), de
            ld ({pvy} + 2), de
            ex de, hl
            ld (bx_y), hl
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld hl, (bx_x)
            add hl, de
            ld ({pvx} + 2), hl
            ld ({pvx} + 4), hl
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld hl, (bx_y)
            add hl, de
            ld ({pvy} + 4), hl
            ld ({pvy} + 6), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({pc}), a
            ld ({pc} + 1), a
            ld a, 4
            ld ({pn}), a
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            call fn_e3_lib_fill
            ld sp, ({sps})
            jr bx_e
bx_x:       dw 0
bx_y:       dw 0
bx_e:
#endasm

' Moon c0, c1, c2: (NEW) the planet (ppos, prad) as a flat disc: dark (c0), lit toward the sun by
' two smaller discs (c1, then c2) shrunk toward the edge nearest the sun - far cheaper than Planet
' for a moon well off (no horizon, no height: palt isn't set)
Public Sub Moon(ByVal c0 As Integer, ByVal c1 As Integer, ByVal c2 As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (mn_c0), de
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (mn_c1), de
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (mn_c2), de
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            ld hl, ({ppos})
            ld ({aimp}), hl
            ld hl, ({ppos} + 2)
            ld ({aimp} + 2), hl
            ld hl, ({ppos} + 4)
            ld ({aimp} + 4), hl
            call fn_e3_lib_aim
            ld hl, ({aimv} + 4)     ; ahead (z 64 on)?
            bit 7, h
            jp nz, mn_end
            ld de, 64
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp c, mn_end
            ld hl, ({aimv} + 4)     ; (the middle more than 2z off to a side: left out)
            add hl, hl
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, ({aimv})
            bit 7, h
            call nz, mn_ng
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp nc, mn_end
            ld hl, ({aimv} + 2)
            bit 7, h
            call nz, mn_ng
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp nc, mn_end
            ld hl, {aimv}
            call fn_e3_lib_len3
            ld (mn_len), hl
            ld hl, ({aimv})         ; its middle on the screen
            ld de, ({aimv} + 2)
            ld bc, ({aimv} + 4)
            call fn_e3_lib_proj
            ld (mn_x), hl
            ld (mn_y), de
            ld hl, ({prad})         ; its radius in the same units: prad x 256 >> aimk
            ld a, ({aimk})
            sub 8
            jr c, mn_sl
            jr z, mn_r0
            ld b, a
mn_sr:
            srl h
            rr l
            djnz mn_sr
            jr mn_r0
mn_sl:
            neg
            ld b, a
mn_sl1:
            add hl, hl
            jp c, mn_end            ; (far too big)
            djnz mn_sl1
mn_r0:
            ld de, 0                ; on the screen: proj(R, 0, the length) - 128
            ld bc, (mn_len)
            call fn_e3_lib_proj
            ld de, -128
            add hl, de
            bit 7, h
            jp nz, mn_end
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr z, mn_r1
            ld hl, 255
mn_r1:
            ld a, l
            or a
            jp z, mn_end
            ld (mn_r), a
            ld hl, (mn_c0)          ; the dark disc
            ld ({pc}), hl
            ld hl, (mn_x)
            ld de, (mn_y)
            ld a, (mn_r)
            call mn_disc
            ld bc, ({suc})          ; the edge toward the sun: S = the middle + (sun x, -sun y) r
            ld a, (mn_r)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            call fn_e3_lib_m14
            ld de, (mn_x)
            add hl, de
            ld (mn_sx), hl
            ld bc, ({suc} + 2)
            ld a, (mn_r)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            call fn_e3_lib_m14
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (mn_y)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (mn_sy), hl
            ld hl, (mn_c1)          ; 3/4 about S
            ld ({pc}), hl
            ld a, 3
            call mn_band
            ld hl, (mn_c2)          ; 1/2 about S
            ld ({pc}), hl
            ld a, 2
            call mn_band
            jp mn_end
mn_band:    ; a disc A / 4 the size, its middle S + (the middle - S) A / 4
            ld (mn_f), a
            ld hl, (mn_x)
            ld de, (mn_sx)
            call mn_lerp
            push hl
            ld hl, (mn_y)
            ld de, (mn_sy)
            call mn_lerp
            ex de, hl
            push de
            ld a, (mn_r)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            call mn_q
            ld a, l
            pop de
            pop hl
            or a
            ret z
mn_disc:    ; a 16 sided disc round HL, DE, radius A (pc)
            ld (mn_dx), hl
            ld (mn_dy), de
            ld (mn_dr), a
            ld ix, {pvx}
            xor a
mn_dl:
            ld (mn_a), a
            call fn_e3_lib_trig     ; A = sin, C = cos (x 127)
            push af
            ld a, (mn_dr)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld a, c
            call fn_e3_lib_mt       ; r cos
            ld de, (mn_dx)
            add hl, de
            ld (ix + 0), l
            ld (ix + 1), h
            pop af
            ld c, a
            ld a, (mn_dr)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld a, c
            call fn_e3_lib_mt       ; r sin
            ld de, (mn_dy)
            add hl, de
            ld (ix + 96), l         ; (pvy: 48 words on)
            ld (ix + 97), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            ld a, (mn_a)
            add a, 16
            jr nz, mn_dl
            ld a, 16
            ld ({pn}), a
            jp fn_e3_lib_fill
mn_lerp:    ; HL = DE + (HL - DE) x f / 4
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            push de
            call mn_q
            pop de
            add hl, de
            ret
mn_q:       ; HL = HL x f / 4 (signed)
            ld a, (mn_f)
            ld b, a
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            ld hl, 0
mn_q1:

mn_ng:

            sub h
            ld h, a

mn_c0:      dw 0
mn_c1:      dw 0
mn_c2:      dw 0
mn_len:     dw 0
mn_x:       dw 0
mn_y:       dw 0
mn_r:       db 0
mn_sx:      dw 0

mn_dy:      dw 0

mn_a:       db 0

#endasm

' ObjSet k, x, y, z, kind, osc, rad, da, db, dc: scene object k: at x, y, z (world), of kind
' (E3Data's ModelTab: its near and far models), size osc, radius rad (world units), turning by da,
' db (256 to the turn) each frame, a dot of colour dc when tiny
Public Sub ObjSet(ByVal k As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal kind As Integer, ByVal sc As Integer, ByVal rad As Integer, ByVal da As Integer, ByVal db As Integer, ByVal dc As Integer)
  Dim p As Integer
  p = k * 8
  obj(p) = x : obj(p + 1) = y : obj(p + 2) = z
  obj(p + 3) = 0
  obj(p + 4) = (da And 255) + (db And 255) * 256
  obj(p + 5) = kind + sc * 256
  obj(p + 6) = rad
  obj(p + 7) = dc
End Sub

' Lib: the Z80 the rest calls (called once by Init so it's linked: it does nothing)
Private Sub Lib()
#asm
            ret
dpage:      db 10                   ; the data's first page (DataOn): slots 6 and 7 between drawings
; ============================================================================ the multiplies
; umul: BC x DE (unsigned) -> HL:DE
umul:
            ld a, e
            ld l, d                 ; (d0 kept in L)
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; c * e0
            push de
            ld d, b
            ld e, a
            mul d, e                ; b * e0
            ld a, l
            ld h, d
            ld l, e
            ld d, c
            ld e, a
            mul d, e                ; c * d0
            add hl, de              ; the middle (17 bits)
            ld c, 0
            rl c
            ld d, b
            ld e, a
            mul d, e                ; b * d0
            ld a, h
            ld b, l
            ex de, hl               ; HL = b * d0
            ld e, a
            ld d, c
            add hl, de              ; + the middle's top
            pop de                  ; c * e0
            ld a, d
            add a, b                ; + the middle's bottom
            ld d, a
            ret nc
            inc hl
            ret
; smul: BC (signed) x DE (unsigned) -> HL:DE (signed)
smul:
            bit 7, b
            jp z, umul
            push de
            call umul
            ex (sp), hl
            ex de, hl
            ex (sp), hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            pop de
            ret
; ssmul: BC x DE (both signed) -> HL:DE
ssmul:
            push bc
            push de
            call umul
            ld (ss_lo), de
            pop de
            pop bc
            bit 7, b
            jr z, ss_1
            or a
            sbc hl, de
ss_1:
            bit 7, d
            jr z, ss_2
            or a
            sbc hl, bc
ss_2:
            ld de, (ss_lo)
            ret
ss_lo:      dw 0
; m14: (BC x DE) >> 14 -> HL (s1.14 products)
m14:
            call ssmul
            ld a, d
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl
            ret
; m816: A (signed) x DE (signed) -> A:HL (24 bits signed)
m816:
            ld c, a
            xor d
            ld (m8_sg), a
            ld a, c
            or a
            jp p, m8_1
            neg
m8_1:
            ld c, a                 ; |a|
            bit 7, d
            jr z, m8_2
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a                 ; |de|
m8_2:
            ld a, d
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |a| * e
            ld h, d
            ld l, e
            ld e, a
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |a| * d
            ld a, e
            add a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, d
            adc a, 0
            ld c, a
            ld a, (m8_sg)
            or a
            ld a, c
            ret p
            ld c, a
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, 0
            sbc a, c
            ret
m8_sg:      db 0
; udivf: HL / DE (unsigned, HL < DE) -> HL = HL * 65536 / DE (HL >= DE: 65535)
udivf:
            push hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            pop hl
            jr c, ud_go
            ld hl, 65535
            ret
ud_go:
            ld bc, 0
            ld a, 16
ud_lp:
            add hl, hl
            jr c, ud_sub
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jr nc, ud_one
            add hl, de
            sla c
            rl b
            dec a
            jr nz, ud_lp
            jr ud_end
ud_sub:
            or a
            sbc hl, de
ud_one:
            scf
            rl c
            rl b
            dec a
            jr nz, ud_lp
ud_end:
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            ret
; absh: HL = |HL|
absh:
            bit 7, h
            ret z
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret
; mrow: (IX: 3 words) . (IY: 3 words) >> 14 -> HL (32 bit sum)
mrow:
            ld c, (ix + 0)
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld e, (iy + 0)
            ld d, (iy + 1)
            call ssmul
            ld (mr_l), de
            ld (mr_h), hl
            ld c, (ix + 2)
            ld b, (ix + 3)
            ld e, (iy + 2)
            ld d, (iy + 3)
            call ssmul
            call mr_add
            ld c, (ix + 4)
            ld b, (ix + 5)
            ld e, (iy + 4)
            ld d, (iy + 5)
            call ssmul
            call mr_add
            ld hl, (mr_h)
            ld a, (mr_l + 1)
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl
            ret
mr_add:
            push hl
            ld hl, (mr_l)
            add hl, de
            ld (mr_l), hl
            pop de
            ld hl, (mr_h)
            adc hl, de
            ld (mr_h), hl
            ret
mr_l:       dw 0
mr_h:       dw 0
; ============================================================================ the camera
; rotp: rows IX (A) and IY (B) of the camera turned by HL / 16384 radians: A = A c + B s,
; B = B c - A s (s = a, c = 1 - a^2 / 2)
rotp:
            ld a, h
            or l
            ret z
            ld (rp_s), hl
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            call ssmul              ; a^2 (s2.28) -> a^2 / 2 in s1.14 is HL:DE >> 15
            ld a, d
            add a, a
            adc hl, hl              ; HL = a^2 >> 15
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 16384
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (rp_c), hl
            ld b, 3
rp_lp:
            push bc
            ld c, (ix + 0)          ; A c
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld de, (rp_c)
            call m14
            ld (rp_t), hl
            ld c, (iy + 0)          ; + B s
            ld b, (iy + 1)
            ld de, (rp_s)
            call m14
            ld de, (rp_t)
            add hl, de
            ld (rp_na), hl
            ld c, (iy + 0)          ; B c
            ld b, (iy + 1)
            ld de, (rp_c)
            call m14
            ld (rp_t), hl
            ld c, (ix + 0)          ; - A s
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld de, (rp_s)
            call m14
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (rp_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (iy + 0), l
            ld (iy + 1), h
            ld hl, (rp_na)
            ld (ix + 0), l
            ld (ix + 1), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc iy
            inc iy
            pop bc
            djnz rp_lp
            ret
rp_s:       dw 0
rp_c:       dw 0
rp_t:       dw 0
rp_na:      dw 0
; renorm: F unit length, U square to F and unit, R = U x F; then the sun in the view
renorm:
            ld ix, {cm} + 12
            call rn_unit
            ld ix, {cm} + 6         ; U -= (U . F) F
            ld iy, {cm} + 12
            call mrow
            ld (rn_d), hl
            ld b, 3
rn_lp:
            push bc
            ld c, (iy + 0)
            ld b, (iy + 1)
            ld de, (rn_d)
            call m14
            ex de, hl
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (ix + 0), l
            ld (ix + 1), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc iy
            inc iy
            pop bc
            djnz rn_lp
            ld ix, {cm} + 6
            call rn_unit
            ; R = U x F: Rx = Uy Fz - Uz Fy, Ry = Uz Fx - Ux Fz, Rz = Ux Fy - Uy Fx
            ld hl, {cm} + 8
            ld de, {cm} + 16
            ld bc, {cm} + 10
            ld ix, {cm} + 14
            call rn_cross
            ld ({cm}), hl
            ld hl, {cm} + 10
            ld de, {cm} + 12
            ld bc, {cm} + 6
            ld ix, {cm} + 16
            call rn_cross
            ld ({cm} + 2), hl
            ld hl, {cm} + 6
            ld de, {cm} + 14
            ld bc, {cm} + 8
            ld ix, {cm} + 12
            call rn_cross
            ld ({cm} + 4), hl
sunv:
            ld iy, {sun}            ; the sun in the view
            ld ix, {cm}
            call mrow
            ld ({suc}), hl
            ld ix, {cm} + 6
            call mrow
            ld ({suc} + 2), hl
            ld ix, {cm} + 12
            call mrow
            ld ({suc} + 4), hl
            ld hl, {cm}             ; the camera >> k (k 0..6, rounded): cms + 18 k
            ld de, cms
            ld bc, 18
            ldir
            ld ix, cms
            ld b, 6 * 9
cs_lp:
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            sra h
            rr l
            ld de, 0
            adc hl, de              ; (rounded: the bit shifted out added back)
            ld (ix + 18), l
            ld (ix + 19), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            djnz cs_lp
            ld hl, {cm}             ; 8 bit copies (>> 7, to +-127): the camera, the sun in the view
            ld de, cm8
            ld b, 9
s8_lp:
            call s8_one
            djnz s8_lp
            ld hl, {suc}
            ld de, suc8
            ld b, 3
s8_l2:
            call s8_one
            djnz s8_l2
            ld hl, {sun}
            ld de, sunw8
            ld b, 3
s8_l3:
            call s8_one
            djnz s8_l3
            ret
s8_one:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            push de
            ld de, 64
            add hl, de
            pop de
            add hl, hl
            ld a, h
            jr c, s8_neg
            cp 128
            jr c, s8_st
            ld a, 127
            jr s8_st
s8_neg:
            cp 129
            jr nc, s8_st
            ld a, 129
s8_st:
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            inc hl
            ret
rn_d:       dw 0
; rn_cross: (HL) x (DE) - (BC) x (IX) (words; s1.14 products) -> HL
rn_cross:
            ld (rc_b), bc
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ex de, hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld b, d
            ld c, e
            ex de, hl
            call m14
            ld (rc_t), hl
            ld hl, (rc_b)
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            ld e, (ix + 0)
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            call m14
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (rc_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret
rc_b:       dw 0
rc_t:       dw 0
; rn_unit: the vector at IX (3 words, near unit length) scaled by (3 - |v|^2) / 2
rn_unit:
            push ix
            pop iy
            call mrow               ; |v|^2 (s1.14)
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 49152
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            srl h
            rr l                    ; (3 - k) / 2
            ld (rn_k), hl
            ld b, 3
ru_lp:
            push bc
            ld c, (ix + 0)
            ld b, (ix + 1)
            ld de, (rn_k)
            call m14
            ld (ix + 0), l
            ld (ix + 1), h
            inc ix
            inc ix
            pop bc
            djnz ru_lp
            ret
rn_k:       dw 0
; ============================================================================ the polygon filler
; fill: pvx, pvy (pn vertices, clockwise on the screen) in the colours pc
fill:
            ld a, ({pn})
            cp 3
            ret c
            push iy
            push ix
            ld (fl_ssp), sp
            ; all on the screen (x 1..255, y 0..192)? Then the fast way, the points as bytes
            cp 49
            jp nc, fl_exit
            ld b, a
            ld hl, {pvx}
            ld de, {pvy}
            ld ix, ff_v
            ld c, 0
            ld a, 255
            ld (ff_ytop), a
            xor a
            ld (ff_ybot), a
fs_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            or a
            jp z, fl_slow           ; x = 0
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            or a
            jp nz, fl_slow          ; x < 0 or over 255
            ld a, (de)
            inc de
            ld (ix + 1), a
            cp 193
            jp nc, fl_slow
            ld a, (de)
            inc de
            or a
            jp nz, fl_slow          ; y < 0 or over 192
            ld a, (ix + 1)          ; the top (the first), the bottom
            push hl
            ld hl, ff_ytop
            cp (hl)
            jr nc, fs_1
            ld (hl), a
            ld a, c
            ld (ff_top), a
            ld a, (ix + 1)
fs_1:
            ld hl, ff_ybot
            cp (hl)
            jr c, fs_2
            ld (hl), a
fs_2:
            pop hl
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc c
            djnz fs_lp
            jp ff
fl_exit:
            ld sp, (fl_ssp)
            ld a, (fn_e3_lib_dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            pop ix
            pop iy
            ret
fl_slow:
            ; not all on the screen: the sides crossed (x < 1, x > 255, y < 0, y > 192); all off one
            ; side: nothing; else cut to them into ff_v, then the fast way
            ld a, ({pn})
            cp 49
            jp nc, fl_exit
            ld b, a
            ld hl, {pvx}
            ld de, {pvy}
            ld c, 0
            ld a, #0F
            ld (c2_and), a
fo_lp:
            push bc
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld l, 0
            bit 7, b
            jr nz, fo_x0
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, fo_x1
            ld a, c
            or a
            jr nz, fo_y
fo_x0:
            set 0, l
            jr fo_y
fo_x1:
            set 1, l
fo_y:
            ld a, (de)
            ld c, a
            inc de
            ld a, (de)
            inc de
            ld b, a
            bit 7, b
            jr nz, fo_y0
            or a
            jr nz, fo_y1
            ld a, c
            cp 193
            jr c, fo_ok
fo_y1:
            set 3, l
            jr fo_ok
fo_y0:
            set 2, l
fo_ok:
            ld a, (c2_and)
            and l
            ld (c2_and), a
            ld a, l
            pop hl
            pop bc
            or c
            ld c, a
            djnz fo_lp
            ld a, (c2_and)
            or a
            jp nz, fl_exit
            ld a, c
            ld (c2_mask), a
            call clip2
            ld a, ({pn})
            cp 3
            jp c, fl_exit
            jp ff
; ---- the fast way: both sides stepped in registers (8.8), no tables. The left side: HL' x,
; DE' its step; the right: IX x (the last pixel), BC' its step; IYH the row's address (high),
; IYL the rows to go; DE the colours
ff:
            call vpoll
            ld a, (ff_ytop)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_ybot)
            cp b
            jp z, fl_exit           ; (flat)
            ld a, b
            ld (ff_y), a
            ld a, ({pn})            ; the points' ends (for going round them)
            add a, a
            sub 2
            ld (ff_lend), a         ; the last one's (low byte)
            add a, 2
            ld (ff_rend), a         ; one past it
            ld a, (ff_top)
            add a, a
            ld l, a
            ld h, ffpage >> 8
            ld (ff_pl), hl
            ld (ff_pr), hl
            ld hl, ff_advl          ; (the events: going round the points)
            ld (ff_cl + 1), hl
            ld hl, ff_advr
            ld (ff_cr + 1), hl
            call ff_advl
            call ff_advr
ff_run:
            ld hl, ({pc})           ; the colours: swapped on odd rows
            ld a, (ff_y)
            rra
            jr nc, ff_c0
            ld a, h
            ld h, l
            ld l, a
ff_c0:
            ld (ff_de), hl
            ld a, 255
            ld (ff_w), a
ff_chunk:
            ld a, (ff_y)            ; n = min(the left's end, the right's, the window's) - y
            or 63
            inc a
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_yl)
            cp b
            jr nc, ff_n1
            ld b, a
ff_n1:
            ld a, (ff_yr)
            cp b
            jr nc, ff_n2
            ld b, a
ff_n2:
            ld a, (ff_y)
            ld c, a
            ld a, b
            sub c
            jr z, ff_ev
            ld (ff_n), a
            ld iyl, a
            ld a, c                 ; the window
            and #C0
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_w)
            cp b
            jr z, ff_wok
            ld a, b
            ld (ff_w), a
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 6
            ld c, a
            ld a, ({back})
            add a, a
            add a, c
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
ff_wok:
            ld a, (ff_y)
            and 63
            or #C0
            ld iyh, a
            ld de, (ff_de)
            jp fr_row
ff_after:
            ld sp, (fl_ssp)
            ld (ff_de), de
            ld a, (ff_n)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_y)
            add a, b
            ld (ff_y), a
ff_ev:
            ld a, (ff_y)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_ybot)
            cp b
            jp z, fl_exit
            jp c, fl_exit
            ld a, (ff_yl)
            cp b
ff_cl:
            call z, ff_advl
            ld a, (ff_y)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_yr)
            cp b
ff_cr:
            call z, ff_advr
            jp ff_chunk
; ff_advl, ff_advr: a side's next edge going down (left: back round the points, right: on). The
; points are ff_v's (x, y) bytes; ff_pl, ff_pr point at each side's current one
ff_advl:
            ld a, (ff_ybot)         ; (none found: to the bottom)
            ld (ff_yl), a
            ld a, ({pn})
            ld b, a                 ; (a guard)
            ld hl, (ff_pl)
al_lp:
            ld a, l
            or a
            jr nz, al_1
            ld a, (ff_lend)
            jr al_2
al_1:
            sub 2
al_2:
            ld e, a
            ld d, h
            inc l
            inc e
            ld a, (de)
            sub (hl)
            ld c, a
            dec l                   ; (inc and dec keep the carry, not the zero)
            dec e
            ret c                   ; (going up: none)
            ld a, c
            or a
            jr z, al_flat
            ld (ff_pl), de
            xor a
            call edge88
            ld (ff_yl), a
            push hl
            push bc
            exx
            pop de
            pop hl
            exx
            ret
al_flat:
            ex de, hl
            djnz al_lp
            ret
ff_advr:
            ld a, (ff_ybot)
            ld (ff_yr), a
            ld a, ({pn})
            ld b, a
            ld hl, (ff_pr)
ar_lp:
            ld a, (ff_rend)
            ld e, a
            ld a, l
            add a, 2
            cp e
            jr nz, ar_1
            xor a
ar_1:
            ld e, a
            ld d, h
            inc l
            inc e
            ld a, (de)
            sub (hl)
            ld c, a
            dec l
            dec e
            ret c
            ld a, c
            or a
            jr z, ar_flat
            ld (ff_pr), de
            ld a, 1
            call edge88
            ld (ff_yr), a
            push hl
            pop ix
            push bc
            exx
            pop bc
            exx
            ret
ar_flat:
            ex de, hl
            djnz ar_lp
            ret
; edge88: the edge from point (HL) to point (DE) (both x, y; going down); A = 1: the right side ->
; HL = x (8.8, from a pixel's middle; the right side's - 1: its last pixel), BC = the step (mod
; 65536: x stays on the screen), A = the end's y
edge88:
            ld (e8_rt), a
            ld a, (de)              ; dx = xb - xa: |dx| in C, its sign in B
            sub (hl)
            ld b, 0
            jr nc, e8_p
            neg
            dec b
e8_p:
            ld c, a
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (e8_xa), a
            inc l
            inc e
            ld a, (de)
            ld (e8_yb), a
            sub (hl)                ; dy
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, fn_e3data_redge_redge_d
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; R = 65536 / dy
            ld a, d
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |dx| R low
            ld l, d
            ld e, a
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |dx| R high
            ld h, 0
            add hl, de              ; |the step| (8.8)
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr z, e8_s
            xor a
            sub l
            ld l, a
            sbc a, a
            sub h
            ld h, a
e8_s:
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld a, (e8_xa)
            ld h, a
            ld l, #80
            ld a, (e8_rt)
            or a
            jr z, e8_l
            dec h
e8_l:
            ld a, (e8_yb)
            ret
e8_rt:      db 0
e8_xa:      db 0
e8_yb:      db 0
; ftri: the triangle of the 3 points listed at HL (in the fast range) filled in pc: its points by
; a pointer into a doubled list (the top first, clockwise), its second edge kept for the event
ftri:
            call vpoll
            push iy
            push ix
            ld (fl_ssp), sp
            ld de, ff_v
            ld b, 3
tr_ld:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            or #40
            ld l, a
            ld h, vpage >> 8
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, l
            xor #C0
            ld l, a
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            djnz tr_ld
            ld hl, ff_v             ; doubled: v0, v1 again after v2
            ld bc, 4
            ldir
            ld hl, ff_v             ; the top
            ld a, (ff_v + 1)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (ff_v + 3)
            cp b
            jr nc, tr_t1
            ld b, a
            ld hl, ff_v + 2
tr_t1:
            ld a, (ff_v + 5)
            cp b
            jr nc, tr_t2
            ld hl, ff_v + 4
tr_t2:
            ld (tr_a), hl           ; A (the top), B, C: tr_a, + 2, + 4
            inc l
            inc l
            ld (tr_b), hl
            inc l
            inc l
            ld (tr_c), hl
            ld a, (tr_a)
            ld l, a
            inc l
            ld a, (hl)              ; ya
            ld (ff_y), a
            ld e, a
            ld hl, (tr_b)
            inc l
            ld b, (hl)              ; yb
            ld hl, (tr_c)
            inc l
            ld c, (hl)              ; yc
            ld a, b
            cp c
            jr nc, tr_bt
            ld a, c
tr_bt:
            ld (ff_ybot), a
            cp e
            jp z, fl_exit           ; (flat)
            xor a
            ld (tr_l2), a
            ld (tr_r2), a
            ld hl, tr_al            ; (the events: the second edges)
            ld (ff_cl + 1), hl
            ld hl, tr_ar
            ld (ff_cr + 1), hl
            ld a, e
            cp b
            jr z, tr_ftr
            cp c
            jr z, tr_ftl
            ld a, b                 ; left A to C, right A to B, then B to C (yb < yc) on the right or C
            cp c                    ; to B (yc < yb) on the left
            jr z, tr_g
            jr nc, tr_gl
            ld a, 1
            ld (tr_r2), a
            jr tr_g
tr_gl:
            ld a, 1
            ld (tr_l2), a
tr_g:
            ld hl, (tr_a)
            ld de, (tr_c)
            call tr_left
            ld hl, (tr_a)
            ld de, (tr_b)
            call tr_right
            jp ff_run
tr_ftr:                             ; flat top, B at its right: left A to C, right B to C
            ld hl, (tr_a)
            ld de, (tr_c)
            call tr_left
            ld hl, (tr_b)
            ld de, (tr_c)
            call tr_right
            jp ff_run
tr_ftl:                             ; flat top, C at its left: left C to B, right A to B
            ld hl, (tr_c)
            ld de, (tr_b)
            call tr_left
            ld hl, (tr_a)
            ld de, (tr_b)
            call tr_right
            jp ff_run
tr_al:                              ; the left's event: C to B if kept, else to the bottom
            ld a, (tr_l2)
            or a
            jr z, tr_none_l
            xor a
            ld (tr_l2), a
            ld hl, (tr_c)
            ld de, (tr_b)
tr_left:
            xor a
            call edge88
            ld (ff_yl), a
            push hl
            push bc
            exx
            pop de
            pop hl
            exx
            ret
tr_none_l:
            ld a, (ff_ybot)
            ld (ff_yl), a
            ret
tr_ar:                              ; the right's event: B to C if kept
            ld a, (tr_r2)
            or a
            jr z, tr_none_r
            xor a
            ld (tr_r2), a
            ld hl, (tr_b)
            ld de, (tr_c)
tr_right:
            ld a, 1
            call edge88
            ld (ff_yr), a
            push hl
            pop ix
            push bc
            exx
            pop bc
            exx
            ret
tr_none_r:
            ld a, (ff_ybot)
            ld (ff_yr), a
            ret
tr_a:       dw 0
tr_b:       dw 0
tr_c:       dw 0
tr_l2:      db 0
tr_r2:      db 0
; ffi: the polygon of the points listed at HL (B of them, all in the fast range: their bytes in
; vpage) filled in pc
ffi:
            ld a, b
            cp 3
            jp z, ftri
            push iy
            push ix
            ld (fl_ssp), sp
            ld a, b
            ld ({pn}), a
            ld ix, ff_v
            ld c, 0
            ld a, 255
            ld (ff_ytop), a
            xor a
            ld (ff_ybot), a
fi_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            or #40
            ld l, a
            ld h, vpage >> 8
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            ld a, l
            xor #C0
            ld l, a
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ix + 1), a
            ld hl, ff_ytop
            cp (hl)
            jr nc, fi_1
            ld (hl), a
            ld e, a
            ld a, c
            ld (ff_top), a
            ld a, e
fi_1:
            ld hl, ff_ybot
            cp (hl)
            jr c, fi_2
            ld (hl), a
fi_2:
            pop hl
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc c
            djnz fi_lp
            jp ff
ff_v:       equ ffpage
ff_top:     db 0
ff_ytop:    db 0
ff_ybot:    db 0
ff_y:       db 0
ff_yl:      db 0
ff_yr:      db 0
ff_pl:      dw 0
ff_pr:      dw 0
ff_lend:    db 0
ff_rend:    db 0
ff_n:       db 0
ff_w:       db 0
ff_de:      dw 0
; fr_row: the fast way's rows (aligned: the pushes end on a 256 byte boundary, so where to jump in
; is the step count negated)
            ALIGN 256
vpage:      ds 256                  ; per vertex i: +i its code, +64 + i its x, +128 + i its y (bytes,
                                    ; in the fast range)
ffpage:     ds 256                  ; ff_v: the fast fill's points (x, y bytes; up to 128)
fr_row:
            exx
            ld a, h                 ; x0
            add hl, de
            db #08                  ; ex af, af
            ld a, ixh               ; x1
            add ix, bc
            exx
            ld b, a
            db #08
            ld c, a
            ld a, iyh
            ld h, a
            inc iyh
            ld a, b
            cp c
            jp c, fr_cont           ; x1 < x0: none
            bit 0, c                ; odd start: one byte (an odd pixel: D)
            jr z, fr_a
            ld l, c
            ld (hl), d
            cp c
            jp z, fr_cont
            inc c
fr_a:
            bit 0, b                ; even end: one byte (E)
            jr nz, fr_b
            ld l, b
            ld (hl), e
            ld a, b
            cp c
            jp z, fr_cont
            dec b
fr_b:
            ld a, b                 ; pairs
            sub c
            add a, 1
            rra
            ld l, b
            inc hl
            db #F9                  ; ld sp, hl
            neg
            ld l, a
            ld h, (fr_pend >> 8) - 1
            jp (hl)
; (NEW) three small routines put in the gap before the pushes' 128 byte line-up (they were   ; <--- NEW
; elsewhere: the gap was empty, 66 bytes)                                                  ; <--- NEW
; trig: A = angle -> A = sin x 127 (signed), C = cos x 127
trig:
            ld hl, fn_e3data_sines_sines_d
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            add hl, de
            ld b, (hl)              ; sin
            add a, 64
            ld e, a
            ld hl, fn_e3data_sines_sines_d
            add hl, de
            ld c, (hl)              ; cos
            ld a, b
            ret
; mul8s: D x E (signed) -> DE
mul8s:
            ld h, d
            ld l, e
            mul d, e
            bit 7, h
            jr z, m8s_1
            ld a, d
            sub l
            ld d, a
m8s_1:
            bit 7, l
            ret z
            ld a, d
            sub h
            ld d, a
            ret
; div10: HL (unsigned) / 10 -> HL, A = the remainder
div10:
            ld b, 16
            xor a
d10_lp:
            add hl, hl
            rla
            cp 10
            jr c, d10_n
            sub 10
            inc l
d10_n:
            djnz d10_lp
            ret
            ALIGN 128
            REPT 128
            push de
            ENDR
fr_pend:
fr_cont:
            ld a, d
            ld d, e
            ld e, a
            dec iyl
            jp nz, fr_row
            jp ff_after
fl_ssp:     dw 0
; clip2: the polygon pvx, pvy (pn points) cut to x 1..255, y 0..192 (Sutherland-Hodgman, one
; side at a time) -> ff_v (bytes), ff_top, ff_ytop, ff_ybot, pn (under 3: nothing left)
clip2:
            ld a, ({pn})
            ld (c2_n), a
            ld b, a
            ld hl, {pvx}
            ld de, {pvy}
            ld ix, c2_a
c2_cp:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ix + 0), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (ix + 1), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (de)
            ld (ix + 2), a
            inc de
            ld a, (de)
            ld (ix + 3), a
            inc de
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            inc ix
            djnz c2_cp
            ld hl, c2_a
            ld (c2_src), hl
            ld hl, c2_b
            ld (c2_dst), hl
            xor a
            ld (c2_bd), a
c2_pass:
            ld a, (c2_bd)           ; (only the sides crossed)
            inc a
            ld b, a
            ld a, (c2_mask)
c2_mb:
            rrca
            djnz c2_mb
            jr nc, c2_skip
            call c2_one
            ld a, (c2_n)
            cp 3
            jr c, c2_none
            ld hl, (c2_src)
            ld de, (c2_dst)
            ld (c2_src), de
            ld (c2_dst), hl
c2_skip:
            ld a, (c2_bd)
            inc a
            ld (c2_bd), a
            cp 4
            jr c, c2_pass
            ld a, (c2_n)            ; to bytes, the top and the bottom found
            cp 100
            jr nc, c2_none
            ld ({pn}), a
            ld b, a
            ld ix, (c2_src)
            ld hl, ff_v
            ld c, 0
            ld a, 255
            ld (ff_ytop), a
            xor a
            ld (ff_ybot), a
c2_bt:
            ld a, (ix + 0)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (ix + 2)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld hl, ff_ytop
            cp (hl)
            jr nc, c2_b1
            ld (hl), a
            ld e, a
            ld a, c
            ld (ff_top), a
            ld a, e
c2_b1:
            ld hl, ff_ybot
            cp (hl)
            jr c, c2_b2
            ld (hl), a
c2_b2:
            pop hl
            ld de, 4
            add ix, de
            inc c
            djnz c2_bt
            ret
c2_none:
            xor a
            ld ({pn}), a
            ret
; c2_one: the list at c2_src (c2_n points) cut by side c2_bd into c2_dst
c2_one:
            ld a, (c2_n)
            ld (c2_k), a
            xor a
            ld (c2_out), a
            ld hl, (c2_dst)
            ld (c2_d), hl
            ld a, (c2_n)            ; the previous: the last
            dec a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, (c2_src)
            add hl, de
            ld (c2_pp), hl
            push hl
            pop ix
            call c2_dist
            ld (c2_dp), hl
            ld ix, (c2_src)
c2_lp:
            call c2_dist
            ld (c2_dc), hl
            ld a, (c2_dp + 1)
            bit 7, a
            jr nz, c2_pout
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, c2_inout
            call c2_emit
            jr c2_nx
c2_inout:
            call c2_isect
            jr c2_nx
c2_pout:
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, c2_nx
            call c2_isect
            call c2_emit
c2_nx:
            ld (c2_pp), ix
            ld hl, (c2_dc)
            ld (c2_dp), hl
            ld de, 4
            add ix, de
            ld a, (c2_k)
            dec a
            ld (c2_k), a
            jr nz, c2_lp
            ld a, (c2_out)
            ld (c2_n), a
            ret
c2_emit:
            push ix
            pop hl
            ld de, (c2_d)
            ld bc, 4
            ldir
            ld (c2_d), de
            ld hl, c2_out
            inc (hl)
            ret
; c2_dist: (IX)'s distance inside side c2_bd: x - 1, 255 - x, y, 192 - y
c2_dist:
            ld a, (c2_bd)
            or a
            jr nz, c2d_1
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            dec hl
            ret
c2d_1:
            dec a
            jr nz, c2d_2
            ld e, (ix + 0)
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            ld hl, 255
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret
c2d_2:
            dec a
            jr nz, c2d_3
            ld l, (ix + 2)
            ld h, (ix + 3)
            ret
c2d_3:
            ld e, (ix + 2)
            ld d, (ix + 3)
            ld hl, 192
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret
; c2_isect: where the edge from the previous point to (IX) crosses the side: t = |dp| / (|dp| +
; |dc|) (65536 / that from REdge; under 256 - halved together till it is)   ; <--- CHANGED (was 1024)
c2_isect:
            ld hl, (c2_dp)
            call absh
            ld (c2_ap), hl
            ld hl, (c2_dc)
            call absh
            ld de, (c2_ap)
            add hl, de              ; the sum
c2_sh:
            ld a, h
            or a                    ; <--- CHANGED (under 256: REdge is 256 long now)
            jr z, c2_r
            srl h
            rr l
            srl d
            rr e
            jr c2_sh
c2_r:
            add hl, hl
            push de
            ld de, fn_e3data_redge_redge_d
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            pop bc                  ; |dp| (halved as the sum)
            call umul               ; t = |dp| R (the low word)
            ld (c2_t), de
            ld hl, (c2_pp)
            ld (c2_pa), hl
            ld a, (c2_bd)
            cp 2
            jr nc, c2_hz
            ; x = the side; y = yp + (yc - yp) t
            ld hl, 1
            or a
            jr z, c2_x1
            ld hl, 255
c2_x1:
            ld (c2_nx_), hl
            ld hl, (c2_pa)
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; yp
            ld l, (ix + 2)
            ld h, (ix + 3)
            call c2_lerp
            ld (c2_ny), hl
            jr c2_put
c2_hz:
            ld hl, 0
            jr z, c2_y0
            ld hl, 192
c2_y0:
            ld (c2_ny), hl
            ld hl, (c2_pa)
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; xp
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            call c2_lerp
            ld (c2_nx_), hl
c2_put:
            ld hl, (c2_d)
            ld de, (c2_nx_)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, (c2_ny)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (c2_d), hl
            ld hl, c2_out
            inc (hl)
            ret
c2_lerp:                            ; DE + (HL - DE) t (rounded) -> HL
            push de
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, (c2_t)
            call smul
            ld bc, #8000
            ex de, hl
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            ld bc, 0
            adc hl, bc
            pop de
            add hl, de
            ret
c2_n:       db 0
c2_and:     db 0
c2_mask:    db 0
c2_k:       db 0
c2_out:     db 0
c2_bd:      db 0
c2_src:     dw 0
c2_dst:     dw 0
c2_d:       dw 0
c2_pp:      dw 0
c2_pa:      dw 0
c2_dp:      dw 0
c2_dc:      dw 0
c2_ap:      dw 0
c2_t:       dw 0
c2_nx_:     dw 0
c2_ny:      dw 0
c2_a:       ds 4 * 60
c2_b:       ds 4 * 60
; ============================================================================ the projection
; proj: HL = x, DE = y, BC = z (> 0) in the view, |x| and |y| at most 2z (about) -> HL = the screen
; x, DE = the screen y. z = n 2^k (n 256..4095; x, y shifted by k too), R = 2^24 / n; then
; x R / 2^17 by three multiplies (the low bytes' product left out: under half a pixel)
proj:
            ld a, b
            and #F0
            jr z, pj_lo
pj_rs:
            srl b                   ; z over 4095: all >> 1
            rr c
            sra h
            rr l
            sra d
            rr e
            ld a, b
            and #F0
            jr nz, pj_rs
            jr pj_n
pj_lo:
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, pj_n
            or c                    ; (z 0: as 1, not forever)
            jr nz, pj_ls
            inc c
pj_ls:
            sla c                   ; z under 256: all << 1
            rl b
            add hl, hl
            sla e
            rl d
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr z, pj_ls
pj_n:
            ld (pj_y), de
            push hl
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            dec h
            add hl, hl
            ld de, d_rproj
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (pj_rl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (pj_rh), a
            pop hl
            call pj_m
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            push hl
            ld hl, (pj_y)
            call pj_m
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 96
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ret
pj_m:                               ; HL (signed) x R >> 17 -> HL
            ld a, h
            ld (pj_sg), a
            bit 7, h
            jr z, pm_1
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
pm_1:
            ld b, h                 ; xh
            ld c, l                 ; xl
            ld a, (pj_rl)
            ld e, a
            ld d, b
            mul d, e                ; xh rl
            push de
            ld a, (pj_rh)
            ld e, a
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; xl rh
            pop hl
            add hl, de              ; m (carry: its bit 16)
            ld l, h
            ld h, 0
            rl h                    ; m >> 8
            ld a, (pj_rh)
            ld e, a
            ld d, b
            mul d, e                ; xh rh
            add hl, de
            srl h                   ; >> 1
            rr l
            ld a, (pj_sg)
            or a
            ret p
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret

pj_rl:      db 0
pj_rh:      db 0
pj_sg:      db 0
; vcode: HL = x, DE = y, BC = z in the view (under 16384 each way) -> A: bit 0 z < 16 (the near
; plane), bit 1 x > 4z, bit 2 -x > 4z, bit 3 y > 4z, bit 4 -y > 4z (a wide guard band: the 2D
; clipper cuts the rest)
vcode:
            ld (vc_x), hl
            ld (vc_y), de
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            ld de, -16
            add hl, de
            ld a, h
            rlca
            and 1
            ld (vc_c), a
            ld hl, (vc_x)
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ex de, hl
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp p, vc_1
            ld a, (vc_c)
            or 2
            ld (vc_c), a
vc_1:
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            adc hl, de
            jp p, vc_2
            ld a, (vc_c)
            or 4
            ld (vc_c), a
vc_2:
            ld hl, (vc_y)
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ex de, hl
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp p, vc_3
            ld a, (vc_c)
            or 8
            ld (vc_c), a
vc_3:
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            adc hl, de
            jp p, vc_4
            ld a, (vc_c)
            or 16
            ld (vc_c), a
vc_4:
            ld a, (vc_c)
            ret
vc_x:       dw 0
vc_y:       dw 0
vc_c:       db 0

; poly3: the polygon in cla (cn records of x, y, z in the view) cut by the planes in cmask (the

            ld hl, {cla}
            ld (p3_src), hl
            ld hl, {clb}
            ld (p3_dst), hl
            xor a
            ld (p3_p), a
p3_pl:
            ld a, (p3_m)
            srl a
            ld (p3_m), a
            jr nc, p3_nx
            call clip1
            ld a, ({cn})
            cp 3
            ret c
            ld hl, (p3_src)
            ld de, (p3_dst)
            ld (p3_src), de
            ld (p3_dst), hl
p3_nx:
            ld a, (p3_p)
            inc a
            ld (p3_p), a
            cp 5
            jr c, p3_pl
            ld a, ({cn})            ; projected into pvx, pvy
            ld ({pn}), a
            ld b, a
            ld ix, (p3_src)
            ld hl, {pvx}
            ld (p3_px), hl
            ld hl, {pvy}
            ld (p3_py), hl
p3_pj:
            push bc
            ld l, (ix + 0)
            ld h, (ix + 1)
            ld e, (ix + 2)
            ld d, (ix + 3)
            ld c, (ix + 4)
            ld b, (ix + 5)
            call proj
            push de
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (p3_px)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (p3_px), hl
            pop de
            ld hl, (p3_py)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (p3_py), hl
            ld de, 6
            add ix, de
            pop bc
            djnz p3_pj
            jp fill
p3_m:       db 0
p3_p:       db 0
p3_src:     dw 0
p3_dst:     dw 0
p3_px:      dw 0
p3_py:      dw 0
; clip1: the list at p3_src (cn records) cut by plane p3_p into p3_dst (cn: how many now)
clip1:
            ld a, ({cn})
            ld (c1_k), a
            xor a
            ld (c1_out), a
            ld hl, (p3_dst)
            ld (c1_d), hl
            ld a, ({cn})            ; the previous: the last
            dec a
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, (p3_src)
            add hl, de
            ld (c1_pp), hl
            push hl
            pop ix
            call cdist
            ld (c1_dp), hl
            ld ix, (p3_src)
c1_lp:
            call cdist
            ld (c1_dc), hl
            ld a, (c1_dp + 1)
            bit 7, a
            jr nz, c1_pout
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, c1_inout
            call c1_emit            ; in, in: the current
            jr c1_nx
c1_inout:
            call c1_isect           ; in, out: where it leaves
            jr c1_nx
c1_pout:
            bit 7, h
            jr nz, c1_nx            ; out, out: nothing
            call c1_isect           ; out, in: where it comes in, the current
            call c1_emit
c1_nx:
            ld (c1_pp), ix
            ld hl, (c1_dc)
            ld (c1_dp), hl
            ld de, 6
            add ix, de
            ld a, (c1_k)
            dec a
            ld (c1_k), a
            jr nz, c1_lp
            ld a, (c1_out)
            ld ({cn}), a
            ret
c1_emit:
            push ix
            pop hl
            ld de, (c1_d)
            ld bc, 6
            ldir
            ld (c1_d), de
            ld hl, c1_out
            inc (hl)
            ret
c1_isect:                           ; t = |dp| / (|dp| + |dc|): p + (c - p) t
            ld hl, (c1_dp)
            call absh
            push hl
            ld hl, (c1_dc)
            call absh
            pop de
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            call udivf
            ld (c1_t), hl
            ld hl, (c1_pp)
            ld (c1_a), hl
            push ix
            pop hl
            ld (c1_b), hl
            ld b, 3
c1_ic:
            push bc
            ld hl, (c1_a)
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld (c1_a), hl
            push de
            ld hl, (c1_b)
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld (c1_b), hl
            ld h, b
            ld l, a
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld de, (c1_t)
            call smul
            pop de
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (c1_d)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld (c1_d), hl
            pop bc
            djnz c1_ic
            ld hl, c1_out
            inc (hl)
            ret
c1_k:       db 0
c1_out:     db 0
c1_d:       dw 0
c1_pp:      dw 0
c1_dp:      dw 0
c1_dc:      dw 0
c1_t:       dw 0
c1_a:       dw 0
c1_b:       dw 0

cdist:

            ld h, (ix + 5)

            ret
cd_1:
            ld e, (ix + 0)
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            cp 3
            jr c, cd_x
            ld e, (ix + 2)
            ld d, (ix + 3)
cd_x:
            sra d
            rr e
            sra d
            rr e
            ld l, (ix + 4)
            ld h, (ix + 5)

            jr z, cd_add

            ret

; (the planet's routine, planet, taken out: Moon, a flat disc, does its job for this game - it
; cost a third of a frame and 3K of room)
; pl_fit: the vector pl_d (3 x 24 bits) shifted right till each fits 15 bits (pl_k: how far) ->
; pl_w (words)
pl_fit:
            ld hl, pl_d
            ld b, 3
pl_fc:
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; middle byte
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; top
            inc hl
            ld e, a
            and #C0
            jr z, pl_fp
            cp #C0
            jr nz, pl_fsh
            ld a, c                 ; negative: top FF
            inc a
            jr nz, pl_fsh
            jr pl_fn
pl_fp:
            ld a, c
            or a
            jr nz, pl_fsh
pl_fn:
            djnz pl_fc
            jr pl_fok
pl_fsh:
            ld hl, pl_d + 8
            ld b, 3
pl_sh:
            sra (hl)
            dec hl
            rr (hl)
            dec hl
            rr (hl)
            dec hl
            djnz pl_sh
            ld hl, pl_k
            inc (hl)
            jr pl_fit
pl_fok:
            ld hl, (pl_d)           ; d as words
            ld (pl_w), hl
            ld hl, (pl_d + 3)
            ld (pl_w + 2), hl
            ld hl, (pl_d + 6)
            ld (pl_w + 4), hl
            ret
; len3: the length of the vector at HL (3 words) -> HL
len3:
            ld (l3_p), hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld b, d
            ld c, e
            call ssmul
            ld (l3_s), de
            ld (l3_s + 2), hl
            ld hl, (l3_p)
            inc hl
            inc hl
            call l3_add
            ld hl, (l3_p)
            ld de, 4
            add hl, de
            call l3_add
            ld hl, (l3_s + 2)
            ld de, (l3_s)
            jp isqrt
l3_add:
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld b, d
            ld c, e
            call ssmul
            push hl
            ld hl, (l3_s)
            add hl, de
            ld (l3_s), hl
            pop de
            ld hl, (l3_s + 2)
            adc hl, de
            ld (l3_s + 2), hl
            ret
l3_p:       dw 0
l3_s:       ds 4
; isqrt: the square root of HL:DE (32 bits) -> HL
isqrt:
            ld (sq_n), de
            ld (sq_n + 2), hl
            ld hl, 0
            ld (sq_r), hl           ; the root
            ld (sq_m), hl           ; the remainder (24 bits)
            xor a
            ld (sq_m + 2), a
            ld b, 16
sq_lp:
            push bc
            ld b, 2                 ; the remainder << 2, the number's top 2 bits into it
sq_sh:
            ld hl, sq_n
            sla (hl)
            inc hl
            rl (hl)
            inc hl
            rl (hl)
            inc hl
            rl (hl)
            ld hl, sq_m
            rl (hl)
            inc hl
            rl (hl)
            inc hl
            rl (hl)
            djnz sq_sh
            ld hl, (sq_r)           ; the root << 1; test = root << 1 | 1 (17 bits)
            add hl, hl
            ld (sq_r), hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            sla e
            rl d
            ld a, 0
            rla                     ; (A: test's bit 16)
            set 0, e
            ld hl, (sq_m)           ; remainder - test
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld c, a
            ld a, (sq_m + 2)
            sbc a, c
            jr c, sq_no
            ld (sq_m), hl
            ld (sq_m + 2), a
            ld hl, sq_r
            set 0, (hl)
sq_no:
            pop bc
            djnz sq_lp
            ld hl, (sq_r)
            ret
sq_n:       ds 4
sq_r:       dw 0
sq_m:       ds 3

pl_r:       ds 3

            ld (hl), a

            push bc

            ld hl, (q3_p)

            ld d, 0

            inc iy
            pop hl
            ld de, 6
            add hl, de

            djnz q3_cm

q3_ad:
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            push hl
            ld l, (iy + 3)
            ld h, (iy + 4)
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld (hl), d
            dec hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc iy
            inc iy
            djnz q3_ad

; vpoll: the raster line now; under the last one looked at: a frame has gone (vbl + 1). Keeps

vp_again:
            ld a, #1E

            in h, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in l, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b

            sbc hl, bc

            inc hl
