tx_wok:
            ld a, e
            and 63
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld a, (tx_x)
            ld l, a
            ld de, (tx_g)
            ld a, (de)
            ld c, a
            ld a, ({txs})
            dec a
            jr nz, tx_big
            ld a, (tx_c)            ; (plain size: the five pixels straight)
            sla c
            jr nc, $ + 3
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            sla c
            jr nc, $ + 3
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            sla c
            jr nc, $ + 3
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            sla c
            jr nc, $ + 3
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            sla c
            jr nc, tx_nx
            ld (hl), a
            jr tx_nx
tx_big:
            inc a
            ld d, a
            ld a, (tx_c)
            ld b, 5
tx_px:
            ld e, d
            sla c
            jr nc, tx_p0
tx_on:
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            dec e
            jr nz, tx_on
            djnz tx_px
            jr tx_nx
tx_p0:
            inc l
            dec e
            jr nz, tx_p0
            djnz tx_px
tx_nx:
            ld hl, tx_r
            inc (hl)
            ld hl, tx_sy
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, tx_rep
            ld hl, (tx_g)
            inc hl
            ld (tx_g), hl
            pop bc
            dec b
            jp nz, tx_row
            ld a, (fn_e3_lib_dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            ret
; chr_u: (NEW) the character on the ULA's screen (bank 5, page 10 put in slot 6 for it): its
; pixels or'd in, the cells it's in given tx_c as their attribute (ink; paper 0: see-through)
chr_u:
            ld a, 10
            db #ED, #92, #56
            ld a, (tx_y)
            ld (tx_r), a
            ld b, 7
cu_row:
            push bc
            ld a, (tx_r)
            cp 192
            jr nc, cu_nx
            call cu_addr
            ld de, (tx_g)           ; the row's 5 pixels (bits 7-3) moved to x's place in the byte
            ld a, (de)
            ld d, a
            ld e, 0
            ld a, (tx_x)
            and 7
            jr z, cu_s0
cu_sh:
            srl d
            rr e
            dec a
            jr nz, cu_sh
cu_s0:
            ld a, (hl)
            or d
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            ld a, (hl)
            or e
            ld (hl), a
cu_nx:
            ld hl, tx_r
            inc (hl)
            ld hl, (tx_g)
            inc hl
            ld (tx_g), hl
            pop bc
            djnz cu_row
            ld a, (tx_y)            ; the attributes: the top row's cells and the bottom's
            call cu_at
            ld a, (tx_y)
            add a, 6
            call cu_at
            ld a, (fn_e3_lib_dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            ret
cu_at:                              ; A: a pixel row - its cells at tx_x and tx_x + 5
            cp 192
            ret nc
            and #F8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld a, (tx_x)
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            and 31
            or l
            ld l, a
            ld a, h
            add a, #D8
            ld h, a
            ld a, (tx_c)
            ld (hl), a
            ld e, a
            ld a, (tx_x)
            and 7
            cp 4
            ret c
            inc l
            ld (hl), e
            ret
; cu_addr: (NEW) HL = the ULA screen's byte (in slot 6) for pixel row A, x tx_x
cu_addr:
            ld e, a
            and 7
            ld h, a
            ld a, e
            and #C0
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            or h
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld a, e
            and #38
            rlca
            rlca
            ld l, a
            ld a, (tx_x)
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            and 31
            or l
            ld l, a
            ret
tx_g:       dw 0
tx_r:       db 0
tx_sy:      db 0
tx_w:       db 0
tx_x:       db 0
tx_y:       db 0
tx_c:       db 0
; tx_step: tx_x on a character (6 x txs)
tx_step:
            ld a, ({txs})
            ld b, a
            ld a, (tx_x)
ts_lp:
            add a, 6
            djnz ts_lp
            ld (tx_x), a
            ret
; aim: the point (aimp: x, y, z / 256 in the world) in the view: aimv (3 words, shifted right by
; aimk to fit 15 bits; its length << aimk is how far)
aim:
            ld ix, {cp}
            ld iy, {aimp}
            ld hl, pl_d
            ld b, 3
am_dl:
            xor a
            sub (ix + 1)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (iy + 0)
            sbc a, (ix + 2)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (iy + 1)
            sbc a, (ix + 3)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld de, 4
            add ix, de
            inc iy
            inc iy
            djnz am_dl
            xor a
            ld (pl_k), a
            call pl_fit
            ld a, (pl_k)
            ld ({aimk}), a
            ld iy, pl_w
            ld ix, {cm}
            call mrow
            ld ({aimv}), hl
            ld ix, {cm} + 6
            call mrow
            ld ({aimv} + 2), hl
            ld ix, {cm} + 12
            call mrow
            ld ({aimv} + 4), hl
            ret
; ============================================================================ the stars
; stars: E3Data's stars (directions) by the camera's 8 bit copy: a pixel each in the view, in its
; colour (none when nstar is 0)
stars:
            ld a, ({nstar})
            or a
            ret z
            ld b, a
            ld hl, d_stars
            ld a, 255
            ld (st_w), a
st_lp:
            push bc
            ld (st_p), hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_v), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_v + 1), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_v + 2), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (st_c), a
            ld ix, cm8 + 6          ; z first: behind - none
            call st_dot
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp m, st_nx
            cp 32                   ; (z under 8192: far off the view)
            jp c, st_nx
            ld (st_z), hl
            ld ix, cm8
            call st_dot
            ld (st_x), hl
            call absh               ; |x| < z
            ld de, (st_z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp nc, st_nx
            ld ix, cm8 + 3
            call st_dot
            ld (st_y), hl
            call absh               ; |y| < z
            ld de, (st_z)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp nc, st_nx
            ld hl, (st_z)           ; R = 2^24 / (z / 4); x R >> 19 (x / 4 by pj_m)
            srl h
            rr l
            srl h
            rr l
            dec h
            add hl, hl
            ld de, d_rproj
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (pj_rl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (pj_rh), a
            ld hl, (st_x)
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            call pj_m
            ld de, 128
            add hl, de
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp nz, st_nx
            ld a, l
            ld (st_sx), a
            ld hl, (st_y)
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            call pj_m
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 96
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld a, h
            or a
            jp nz, st_nx
            ld a, l
            ld hl, {stymax}
            cp (hl)
            jp nc, st_nx
            ld e, a                 ; the pixel
            rlca
            rlca
            and 3
            ld d, a
            ld a, (st_w)
            cp d
            jr z, st_wok
            ld a, d
            ld (st_w), a
            add a, a
            ld c, a
            ld a, ({back})
            add a, a
            add a, c
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
st_wok:
            ld a, e
            and 63
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld a, (st_sx)
            ld l, a
            ld a, (st_c)
            ld (hl), a
            ld a, 255               ; (the data pages back: the stars and RProj are in them)
            ld (st_w), a
            ld a, (dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
st_nx:
            ld hl, (st_p)
            ld de, 4
            add hl, de
            pop bc
            ld a, b
            and 7
            call z, vpoll
            dec b
            jp nz, st_lp
            ld a, (fn_e3_lib_dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            ret
st_dot:                             ; (IX: 3 bytes of the camera) . the star -> HL
            ld d, (ix + 0)
            ld a, (st_v)
            ld e, a
            call mul8s
            push de
            ld d, (ix + 1)
            ld a, (st_v + 1)
            ld e, a
            call mul8s
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            push hl
            ld d, (ix + 2)
            ld a, (st_v + 2)
            ld e, a
            call mul8s
            pop hl
            add hl, de
            ret
st_p:       dw 0
st_v:       ds 3
st_c:       db 0
st_w:       db 0
st_sx:      db 0
st_x:       dw 0
st_y:       dw 0
st_z:       dw 0
; ============================================================================ the scene
; scene: the objects in obj (nobj records of 16 bytes: x, y, z, oa, ob, da, db, kind, osc, rad,
; dot colour) turned by their spins, those seen sorted far to near and drawn: near ones by their
; kind's near model, far ones (rad * 8 < z) by its far model, tiny ones (rad * 64 < z) as dots
scene:
            xor a
            ld (sc_n), a
            ld a, ({scene0})        ; objects scene0 .. nobj - 1
            ld (sc_i), a
            ld b, a
            ld a, ({nobj})
            sub b
            ret z
            ret c
            ld (sc_k), a
            ld l, b
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld de, {obj}
            add hl, de
            ld (sc_p), hl
sc_lp:
            ld hl, (sc_p)
            ld de, 10
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)              ; (kind 255: not there - left out)
            inc a
            jp z, sc_nx
            call vpoll
            ld hl, (sc_p)
            ld de, {op}
            ld bc, 6
            ldir                    ; the position
            ld a, (hl)              ; turned: oa += da, ob += db
            inc hl
            inc hl
            add a, (hl)
            dec hl
            dec hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            inc hl
            add a, (hl)
            dec hl
            dec hl
            ld (hl), a
            ld de, 5
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({orad}), de
            ld a, ({scache})
            or a
            jr z, sc_o8
            ld a, (sc_i)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld (sc_vo), hl
            ld de, {vwz}
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld hl, #8000
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp z, sc_nx
            ld hl, 32767
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp z, sc_nx
            ld ({oc} + 4), de
            ld hl, (sc_vo)
            ld de, {vwx}
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({oc}), de
            ld hl, (sc_vo)
            ld de, {vwy}
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({oc} + 2), de
            call ocull
            jr sc_ov
sc_o8:
            call oprep8
sc_ov:
            ld a, ({ovis})
            or a
            jp z, sc_nx
            ld hl, ({oc} + 4)       ; into the list, far first
            ld (sc_zn), hl
            ld a, (sc_n)
            ld b, a
sc_in:
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr z, sc_put
            dec a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, sc_z
            add hl, de
            ld (sc_pz), hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld hl, (sc_zn)
            ex de, hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            jp p, sc_put            ; z(j - 1) >= z: here
            ld hl, (sc_pz)          ; z(j) = z(j - 1)
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ld hl, sc_x - 1         ; x(j) = x(j - 1)
            ld e, b
            ld d, 0
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld (hl), a
            dec b
            jr sc_in
sc_put:
            ld a, b
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, sc_z
            add hl, de
            ld de, (sc_zn)
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            ld hl, sc_x
            ld e, b
            ld d, 0
            add hl, de
            ld a, (sc_i)
            ld (hl), a
            ld hl, sc_n
            inc (hl)
sc_nx:
            ld hl, (sc_p)
            ld de, 16
            add hl, de
            ld (sc_p), hl
            ld hl, sc_i
            inc (hl)
            ld hl, sc_k
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, sc_lp
            ; ---- drawn far to near
            ld a, (sc_n)
            or a
            ret z
            ld (sc_k), a
            xor a
            ld (sc_j), a
sc_dl:
            call vpoll
            ld a, (sc_j)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, sc_x
            add hl, de
            ld l, (hl)              ; P = obj + 16 i
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld de, {obj}
            add hl, de
            ld de, {op}
            ld bc, 6
            ldir
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({oa}), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({ob}), a
            inc hl
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; the kind
            ld (sc_kind), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({osc}), a
            inc hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({orad}), de
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (sc_dc), a           ; the dot's colour
            ld a, (sc_j)            ; z: how far
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, sc_z
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ex de, hl               ; HL = z: how big (128 rad / z): over 32 pixels near (exact, the
            ld b, 2                 ; near model); 16..32 far (the cheap way, the near model); 4..16
            call sc_shr             ; far (the far model); 2..4 a blob; under 2 a dot
            ld c, 0
            ld a, 0
            jr nc, sc_mod
            ld b, 1
            call sc_shr
            ld a, 1
            jr nc, sc_mod
            ld a, ({lodb})          ; <--- CHANGED (was 2: the far model down to 4 pixels; lodb 1:
            ld b, a                 ; <--- NEW      down to 8, then a blob - cheaper with many far off)
            call sc_shr
            ld c, 2
            ld a, 1                 ; <--- NEW (A as it was)
            jr nc, sc_mod
            ld b, 1
            call sc_shr
            jp nc, sc_blob
            jr sc_dot
sc_mod:
            ld (od_far), a
            ld a, (sc_kind)
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, c
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, d_modeltab
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld hl, d_modeldata
            add hl, de
            ld ({omod}), hl
            call odraw
            jr sc_dnx
sc_blob:
            ld a, 1
            ld (sc_isb), a
            jr sc_db
sc_dot:
            xor a
            ld (sc_isb), a
sc_db:
            call oprep8
            ld a, ({ovis})
            or a
            jr z, sc_dnx
            ld hl, ({oc})
            ld de, ({oc} + 2)
            ld bc, ({oc} + 4)
            ld a, b
            or a
            jp m, sc_dnx
            ld a, c
            cp 16
            jr nc, sc_dp
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr z, sc_dnx            ; (z under 16)
sc_dp:
            ld a, (sc_isb)
            or a
            jr nz, sc_bl
            call proj
            ld a, (sc_dc)
            call dot
            jr sc_dnx
sc_bl:
            call blob
sc_dnx:
            ld hl, sc_j
            inc (hl)
            ld hl, sc_k
            dec (hl)
            jp nz, sc_dl
            ret
sc_shr:                             ; carry: HL >> B > orad (HL kept shifted)
            sra h
            rr l
            djnz sc_shr
            push hl
            ld de, ({orad})
            ex de, hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de              ; orad - (z >> n) < 0: carry
            pop hl
            jp m, sc_sc
            or a
            ret
sc_sc:
            scf
            ret
; blob: the object at oc as a hexagon its size on the screen (orad), in its dot colour (dithered
; with the next shade)
blob:
            ld (bl_z), bc
            push hl
            push de
            call proj               ; the middle
            ld (bl_x), hl
            ld (bl_y), de
            ld hl, ({orad})         ; the size: (128 + rad 128 / z) - 128
            ld de, 0
            ld bc, (bl_z)
            call proj
            ld de, -128
            add hl, de
            pop de
            pop de
            ld a, h
            or a
            ret nz
            ld a, l
            or a
            ret z
            ld (bl_r), a
            srl a
            ld (bl_r2), a           ; r / 2
            ld a, (bl_r)            ; r * 7 / 8
            ld b, a
            srl a
            srl a
            srl a
            neg
            add a, b
            ld (bl_r7), a
            ld ix, {pvx}            ; clockwise from the top left
            ld de, (bl_r2)
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, (bl_x)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (ix + 0), l
            ld (ix + 1), h
            ld (ix + 8), l
            ld (ix + 9), h
            ld hl, (bl_x)
            add hl, de
            ld (ix + 2), l
            ld (ix + 3), h
            ld (ix + 6), l
            ld (ix + 7), h
            ld a, (bl_r)
            ld e, a
            ld hl, (bl_x)
            add hl, de
            ld (ix + 4), l
            ld (ix + 5), h
            ld hl, (bl_x)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (ix + 10), l
            ld (ix + 11), h
            ld a, (bl_r7)
            ld e, a
            ld hl, (bl_y)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld (ix + 96), l
            ld (ix + 97), h
            ld (ix + 98), l
            ld (ix + 99), h
            ld hl, (bl_y)
            add hl, de
            ld (ix + 102), l
            ld (ix + 103), h
            ld (ix + 104), l
            ld (ix + 105), h
            ld hl, (bl_y)
            ld (ix + 100), l
            ld (ix + 101), h
            ld (ix + 106), l
            ld (ix + 107), h
            ld a, 6
            ld ({pn}), a
            ld a, (sc_dc)
            ld l, a
            inc a
            ld h, a
            ld ({pc}), hl
            jp fill
bl_x:       dw 0
bl_y:       dw 0
bl_z:       dw 0
bl_r:       db 0
bl_r2:      db 0
            db 0
bl_r7:      db 0
; dot: HL = x, DE = y on the screen, A = the colour: 2 x 2 pixels
dot:
            ld (dt_c), a
            ld a, h
            or d
            ret nz
            ld a, l
            cp 255
            ret nc
            ld a, e
            cp 191
            ret nc
            rlca
            rlca
            and 3
            add a, a
            ld c, a
            ld a, ({back})
            add a, a
            add a, c
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            ld a, e
            and 63
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld a, (dt_c)
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            ld (hl), a
            inc h
            jr z, dt_e              ; (the row's in the next window: left out)
            ld (hl), a
            dec l
            ld (hl), a
dt_e:
            ld a, (fn_e3_lib_dpage)
            db #ED, #92, #56
            inc a
            db #ED, #92, #57
            ret
dt_c:       db 0
sc_n:       db 0
sc_k:       db 0
sc_i:       db 0
sc_j:       db 0
sc_p:       dw 0
sc_zn:      dw 0
sc_pz:      dw 0
sc_kind:    db 0
sc_dc:      db 0
sc_isb:     db 0
sc_vo:      dw 0
sc_z:       ds 128
sc_x:       ds 64
; ============================================================================ objects
; reld: HL (a position, world, 16 bits) - the camera's (IX: 32 bits, 24.8) -> HL, carry: too far
; (over 16000 any way)
reld:
            ld a, h
            rla
            sbc a, a
            ld c, a
            ld a, l
            sub (ix + 1)
            ld l, a
            ld a, h
            sbc a, (ix + 2)
            ld h, a
            ld a, c
            sbc a, (ix + 3)
            ld c, a
            ld a, h
            rla
            sbc a, a
            cp c
            jr nz, rd_far
            bit 7, h
            jr z, rd_pos
            ld de, 16000
            push hl
            add hl, de
            pop hl
            ccf
            ret
rd_pos:
            ld de, 16001
            push hl
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            pop hl
            ccf
            ret
rd_far:
            scf
            ret
; ctest: HL = a plane's distance, DE = the radius -> A: 0 inside, 1 crossing, 2 outside
ctest:
            push hl
            or a
            adc hl, de
            pop hl
            ld a, 2
            ret m
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld a, 1
            ret m
            xor a
            ret
; ocull: oc (in the view), orad -> ovis: 0 outside, 1 all in, 2 crossing the view's edges
ocull:
            xor a
            ld (op_part), a

            ld d, h

            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            srl d
            rr e
            add hl, de
            ld (op_rk), hl
            ld hl, ({oc} + 4)       ; near: z - 16
            ld de, -16
            add hl, de
            ld de, ({orad})
            call ctest
            call op_acc
            jp z, op_out
            ld hl, ({oc})           ; z - x / 4
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, ({oc} + 4)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, (op_rk)
            call ctest
            call op_acc
            jp z, op_out
            ld hl, ({oc})           ; z + x / 4
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ld de, ({oc} + 4)
            add hl, de
            ld de, (op_rk)
            call ctest
            call op_acc
            jp z, op_out
            ld hl, ({oc} + 2)       ; z - y / 4
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, ({oc} + 4)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld de, (op_rk)
            call ctest
            call op_acc
            jp z, op_out
            ld hl, ({oc} + 2)       ; z + y / 4
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ld de, ({oc} + 4)
            add hl, de
            ld de, (op_rk)
            call ctest
            call op_acc
            jp z, op_out
            ld a, (op_part)
            inc a
            ld ({ovis}), a
            xor a
            ld ({ovis} + 1), a
            ret
op_out:
            xor a
            ld ({ovis}), a
            ld ({ovis} + 1), a
            ret
op_acc:                             ; A (ctest): Z set when outside
            cp 2
            ret z
            ld b, a
            ld a, (op_part)
            or b
            ld (op_part), a
            or 1
            ret

op_rk:      dw 0
; orel: od = op - the camera; carry: too far
orel:

            ld hl, ({op} + 2)
            call reld
            ret c
            ld ({od} + 2), hl
            ld ix, {cp} + 8
            ld hl, ({op} + 4)
            call reld
            ret c
            ld ({od} + 4), hl
            ret
; oprep: od, oc (exact), ovis
oprep:
            call orel
            jr c, op_out
            ld iy, {od}
            ld ix, {cm}
            call mrow
            ld ({oc}), hl
            ld ix, {cm} + 6
            call mrow
            ld ({oc} + 2), hl
            ld ix, {cm} + 12
            call mrow
            ld ({oc} + 4), hl
            jp ocull

            ld d, (ix + 1)

            add hl, de
            ld (o8_s), hl
            inc ix
            inc ix
            pop bc
            djnz o8_t
            pop de
            ld hl, (o8_s)
            ex de, hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d

mt:

            jr z, mt_z              ; <--- NEW  things turned about y only have many)
            ld c, a
            ld a, d                 ; <--- NEW
            or e                    ; <--- NEW
            jr z, mt_z              ; <--- NEW
            ld a, c                 ; <--- NEW
            xor d
            ld (mt_sg), a
            ld a, c
            or a
            jp p, mt_1
            neg

mt_1:
            bit 7, d
            jr z, mt_2
            xor a
            sub e
            ld e, a
            sbc a, a
            sub d
            ld d, a
mt_2:
            ld a, d                 ; hi
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |a| lo
            ex de, hl
            add hl, hl              ; (carry, H) = |a| lo >> 7
            ld l, h
            ld h, 0
            rl h
            ld e, a
            ld d, c
            mul d, e                ; |a| hi
            ex de, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; 2 |a| hi + (|a| lo >> 7)
            ld a, (mt_sg)
            or a
            ret p
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ret

            ld h, a                 ; <--- NEW (A is 0 here)
            ld l, a                 ; <--- NEW
            ret                     ; <--- NEW

            sbc hl, de
            jp m, of_skip
            jp z, of_skip
            jp of_lit
ow_pt:                              ; point A -> BC = x, DE = y (16 bits)
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, {osx}
            add hl, de
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)
            ld hl, {osy}
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ret
ow_sub:                             ; BC = BC - HL
            push de
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            ld h, b
            ld l, c
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            pop de
            ret
ow_x0:      dw 0
ow_y0:      dw 0
ow_a:       dw 0
ow_b:       dw 0
ow_c:       dw 0
ow_d:       dw 0
; of_e: oe = O^T (-od) >> osc (the camera in the model: by the object's turn, to about 1%)
of_e:
            ld hl, ({od})           ; Ry^T: x1 = ca x - sa z, z1 = sa x + ca z (x, z = -od)
            call oe_neg
            ld a, (od_ca)
            call mt
            ld (oe_t), hl
            ld hl, ({od} + 4)
            call oe_neg
            ld a, (od_sa)
            call mt
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (oe_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            call oe_sh
            ld ({oe}), hl
            ld hl, ({od})
            call oe_neg
            ld a, (od_sa)
            call mt
            ld (oe_t), hl
            ld hl, ({od} + 4)
            call oe_neg
            ld a, (od_ca)
            call mt
            ld de, (oe_t)
            add hl, de
            ld (oe_z1), hl
            ld hl, ({od} + 2)       ; Rx^T: y = cb y1 + sb z1, z = cb z1 - sb y1 (y1 = -od y)
            call oe_neg
            ld a, (od_cb)
            call mt
            ld (oe_t), hl
            ld de, (oe_z1)
            ld a, (od_sb)
            call mt
            ld de, (oe_t)
            add hl, de
            call oe_sh
            ld ({oe} + 2), hl
            ld de, (oe_z1)
            ld a, (od_cb)
            call mt
            ld (oe_t), hl
            ld hl, ({od} + 2)
            call oe_neg
            ld a, (od_sb)
            call mt
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, (oe_t)
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            call oe_sh
            ld ({oe} + 4), hl
            ld a, 1
            ld (oe_ok), a
            ret
oe_neg:                             ; DE = -HL
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ex de, hl
            ret
oe_sh:                              ; HL >> osc
            ld a, ({osc})
            or a
            ret z
            ld b, a
oe_s:
            sra h
            rr l
            djnz oe_s
            ret
oe_t:       dw 0
oe_z1:      dw 0
of_a:       db 0
of_b:       db 0
of_c:       db 0
of_d:       db 0
of_as:      db 0
of_bs:      db 0
of_cs:      db 0
of_ds:      db 0
xv_i:       db 0
xv_or:      db 0
; ndot: the face's normal (IY + 2..4, int8) . the 3 words at HL -> nd_h:nd_l (24 bits)
ndot:
            ld (nd_v), hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld a, (iy + 2)
            call m816
            ld (nd_l), hl
            ld (nd_h), a
            ld hl, (nd_v)
            inc hl
            inc hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld a, (iy + 3)
            call m816
            call nd_add
            ld hl, (nd_v)
            ld de, 4
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld a, (iy + 4)
            call m816
nd_add:
            ld c, a
            ld de, (nd_l)
            add hl, de
            ld (nd_l), hl
            ld a, (nd_h)
            adc a, c
            ld (nd_h), a
            ret
nd_v:       dw 0
nd_l:       dw 0
nd_h:       db 0
xv_k:       db 0
of_k:       db 0
of_n:       db 0
of_ix:      dw 0
xv_p:       dw 0
xv_o:       dw 0
xv_sx:      dw 0
xv_sy:      dw 0
xv_o0:      dw 0
xv_o1:      dw 0
xv_o2:      dw 0
cm8:        ds 9
suc8:       ds 3
sunw8:      ds 3
cms:        ds 126                  ; the camera >> 0..6 (rounded): C' = cms(6 - osc) O
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Nx.cls
files.text:
' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Obj3D.cls
files.text:
' Obj3D - NTC3D's objects: a table of up to 32 things in the world, each moved by itself every
' frame (in Z80) by its mover, tested for hits against the things its mask says it cares about,
' and drawn through E3 - so a game's BASIC only says what's what and answers what happened.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' An object (slot 0 .. NOBJ - 1): a model kind (E3Data's K_ constants) at a size (a model unit is
' 2^size world units), where it is (E3.obj: Pos / Move), its speed a 50th (ovx, ovy, ovz), its
' class (ocls: 0 = a free slot; CL_ constants, or your own 7 - 15) and its mask (omask: one bit per
' class it hits - bit c is 2^c, CL_PLAYER's bit is the camera), its hit box (ohw across and along,
' ohh up: half sizes, world units; the model's own from the model tool, times its size), its mover
' (omv, MV_ constants) with the mover's state (ost), timer (otm) and settings (opa, opb, ospd,
' odist: what each means is the mover's), flags (oflg, OF_ constants), a life (olife: 50ths to
' go, it's taken out at 0; 0 = for ever), a gun (ogun: 50ths till it's ready; ready with you in
' front of it, 700 - 8500 ahead: an EV_FIRE event), and two numbers of yours (otype, ouv).
'
' Each frame: Update dt (the 50ths gone) moves everything, then finds the hits and puts every
' happening on a queue the game reads with NextEvent; Draw draws them all (after the background).
' Update needs the camera's speed (pvx, pvy, pvz: a 50th's move, world units) and its lagging
' way ahead (hfx, hfy, hfz, s1.14) for the movers that keep station in front of you: Fly3D.Steer
' keeps them, or set them yourself.
Option Explicit

Public Const NOBJ = 44                           ' objects: 32, or game.json's nobj (the build sets it, E3's tables too)   ' @nobj   ' <--- CHANGED

' classes (ocls) and their mask bits (2 ^ class)
Public Const CL_PLAYER = 1, CL_ENEMY = 2, CL_EBOLT = 3, CL_PBOLT = 4, CL_SCENERY = 5, CL_DEBRIS = 6
Public Const M_PLAYER = 2, M_ENEMY = 4, M_EBOLT = 8, M_PBOLT = 16, M_SCENERY = 32, M_DEBRIS = 64

' movers (omv)
Public Const MV_STILL = 0       ' stays put (its spin still turns it)
Public Const MV_STRAIGHT = 1    ' on by its speed
Public Const MV_FALL = 2        ' on by its speed, the speed down growing by opa a 50th (debris)
Public Const MV_BLAST = 3       ' a fireball: still, one size bigger for its last 8 50ths of life
Public Const MV_HOLD = 4        ' keeps station ahead of you, weaving: odist ahead, opa across, opb
                                ' up (world x, y); held otm 50ths, then a run in (to 1500 ahead),
                                ' a break off up and out (5000 ahead), and back (ost: 0, 1, 2)
Public Const MV_HOLDONLY = 5    ' as MV_HOLD but never runs in (a big ship: always on station)
Public Const MV_CHARGE = 6      ' straight at you; within 2500 it goes on through (MV_PASS)
Public Const MV_PASS = 7        ' on through, facing its way; taken out 3000 behind you
Public Const MV_TURN = 8        ' turns after you and keeps after you, odist ahead of you (opa
                                ' across, opb up: 0s and it comes right at you)
Public Const MV_WEAVE = 9       ' on by its speed, swaying: opa across, opb up (amounts)
Public Const MV_ORBIT = 10      ' round (opa, opb) (world x, z) at odist, ospd 256ths of a turn a
                                ' second (its height stays)
' (NEW) on the ground (x and z only: its height stays), steered at up to opa a 50th each way,      ' <--- NEW
' turning to look along its way (or at you when it stands)                                       ' <--- NEW
Public Const MV_CIRCLE = 11     ' round you at odist, ospd 256ths of a turn a second (- the other   ' <--- NEW
                                ' way), looking at you: strafing                                 ' <--- NEW
Public Const MV_HUNT = 12       ' drives at you till it's odist off, then creeps round you facing you; every   ' <--- NEW
                                ' 3 s or so it falls back behind object opb (cover: -1 none) for   ' <--- NEW
                                ' 2 s (ost 0: hunting, 1: in cover)                              ' <--- NEW
Public Const MV_HOME = 13       ' homes in on you (in 3D: a missile), up to opa a 50th each way   ' <--- NEW
' (MV_HOLD .. MV_TURN: ospd is how much faster than you it may go, a 50th)

' flags (oflg)
Public Const OF_BEHIND = 1      ' taken out when 2500 behind you along the world's z (a run)
Public Const OF_WRAP = 2        ' put back 9000 ahead of you (at opa, opb) when 14000 away
Public Const OF_FACECAM = 4     ' turned to look at you
Public Const OF_FACEVEL = 8     ' turned to look along its way
Public Const OF_LAND = 16       ' (NEW) on reaching the ground (y down to gy): stopped there, an   ' <--- NEW
                                ' EV_LAND event, the flag cleared (a shell, a bomb)              ' <--- NEW
Public Const OF_GUNANY = 32     ' (NEW) its gun's ready with you anywhere within 8500 (not only   ' <--- NEW
                                ' in front of you: on the ground they come from all round)      ' <--- NEW

' events (NextEvent)
Public Const EV_FIRE = 1        ' ea's gun is ready, you're in front of it (re-arm: ogun(ea) = n)
Public Const EV_HIT = 2         ' ea hit eb (eb 255: you - the camera passed through it)
Public Const EV_LAND = 3        ' (NEW) ea (OF_LAND) has come down to the ground                  ' <--- NEW

Public ocls(43) As Integer, omask(43) As Integer, omv(43) As Integer, oflg(43) As Integer   ' @objarr   ' <--- CHANGED (the build sets the size: game.json nobj)
Public ost(43) As Integer, otm(43) As Integer, olife(43) As Integer, ogun(43) As Integer   ' @objarr   ' <--- CHANGED (the build sets the size: game.json nobj)
Public otype(43) As Integer, ouv(43) As Integer   ' @objarr   ' <--- CHANGED (the build sets the size: game.json nobj)
Public ovx(43) As Integer, ovy(43) As Integer, ovz(43) As Integer   ' @objarr   ' <--- CHANGED (the build sets the size: game.json nobj)
Public opa(43) As Integer, opb(43) As Integer, ospd(43) As Integer, odist(43) As Integer   ' @objarr   ' <--- CHANGED (the build sets the size: game.json nobj)
Public ohw(43) As Integer, ohh(43) As Integer   ' @objarr   ' <--- CHANGED (the build sets the size: game.json nobj)
Private olz(43) As Integer                       ' its view z last frame (passing through you)   ' @objarr   ' <--- CHANGED

Public pvx As Integer, pvy As Integer, pvz As Integer   ' your speed (a 50th's move)
Public hfx As Integer, hfy As Integer, hfz As Integer   ' your way ahead, lagging (s1.14)
Public lo As Integer, hi As Integer              ' Spawn takes the first free slot in lo .. hi - 1
Public gy As Integer                             ' (NEW) the ground's height for OF_LAND   ' <--- NEW
Public ea As Integer, eb As Integer              ' NextEvent: the objects
Public px As Integer, py As Integer, pz As Integer   ' Pos: where it is
Public avx As Integer, avy As Integer, avz As Integer   ' Aim's speed
Public pky As Integer                            ' (NEW) Pick: the gun's line up the view, 128ths of z (0: straight ahead; a gun raised)   ' <--- NEW
' bolts, debris and fireballs: their models (BoltModel, DebrisModel, BlastModel)
Public bkind As Integer, bsc As Integer, bdot As Integer, blife As Integer, pmask As Integer
Public dkind As Integer, dsc As Integer, ddot As Integer, dgrav As Integer
Public dflg As Integer                           ' (NEW) Burst's debris's flags (OF_LAND: they come down and lie on the ground)   ' <--- NEW
Public xkind As Integer, xdot As Integer
Private evq(31) As Integer, evb(31) As Integer, nev As Integer, rdq As Integer
Private pobj As Integer, pvwx As Integer, pvwy As Integer, pvwz As Integer, pcp As Integer
Private sps As Integer, six As Integer, t As Integer

' Init: after E3.Init - every slot free, the bolts' and the debris's models unset
Public Sub Init()
  pobj = VarPtr(E3.obj) : pcp = VarPtr(E3.cp)
  pvwx = VarPtr(E3.vwx) : pvwy = VarPtr(E3.vwy) : pvwz = VarPtr(E3.vwz)
  hfx = 0 : hfy = 0 : hfz = 16384 : lo = 0 : hi = NOBJ
  bkind = -1 : dkind = -1 : xkind = -1 : blife = 120 : pmask = M_ENEMY + M_SCENERY
  Lib
  Clear
End Sub

' Clear: every object taken out, the events forgotten
Public Sub Clear()
  For t = 0 To NOBJ - 1
    Kill t
  Next
  nev = 0 : rdq = 0
End Sub

' Kill i: object i taken out (its slot free)
Public Sub Kill(ByVal i As Integer)
  ocls(i) = 0
  E3.obj(i * 8 + 5) = 255
End Sub

' Spawn(kind, size, class, x, y, z, dot): a new object in the first free slot of lo .. hi - 1 (-1:
' none free). Its mover MV_STILL, no speed, flags, mask, life or gun; its hit box and radius from
' the model; dot: its colour when it's too small to draw (a dot)
Public Function Spawn(ByVal kind As Integer, ByVal sc As Integer, ByVal cls As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal dot As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld hl, -1
            ld ({t}), hl
            ld a, ({lo})            ; the first free slot
            ld b, a
            ld a, ({hi})
            sub b
            jp z, sp_end
            jp c, sp_end
            ld c, a
            ld a, b
            ld (fn_obj3d_lib_o3_i), a
sp_find:
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_cur
            ld hl, {ocls}
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_rdw
            ld a, h
            or l
            jr z, sp_got
            ld hl, fn_obj3d_lib_o3_i
            inc (hl)
            dec c
            jr nz, sp_find
            jp sp_end
sp_got:
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_zero   ; every one of its numbers 0
            ld bc, #7FFF                ; <--- NEW (its view z last frame: none yet - no hit on
            ld hl, {olz}                ; <--- NEW  its first frame from the either-way test)
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_wrw    ; <--- NEW
            ld bc, ({cls})
            ld hl, {ocls}
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_wrw
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_objp   ; its scene record: x, y, z, no turns or spins, kind, size
            ld de, ({x})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, ({y})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld de, ({z})
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            xor a
            ld b, 4
sp_z4:
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            djnz sp_z4
            ld a, ({kind})
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, ({sc})
            and 7
            ld (sp_s), a
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld a, ({kind})          ; the radius: the near model's (its byte 2) x 2^size
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld de, d_modeltab
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld hl, d_modeldata + 2
            add hl, de
            ld l, (hl)
            ld h, 0
            call sp_sh
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
            inc hl
            ld a, ({dot})           ; the dot's colour, no scanner colour
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            ld a, ({kind})          ; the hit box: the model's (d_hittab: across, up) x 2^size
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            ld de, d_hittab
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            call sp_sh
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, {ohw}
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_wrw
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)
            ld h, 0
            call sp_sh
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, {ohh}
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_wrw
            ld hl, ({pvwz})         ; not in the view till ViewAll sees it
            ld de, (fn_obj3d_lib_o3_o)
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), 0
            inc hl
            ld (hl), #80
            ld a, (fn_obj3d_lib_o3_i)
            ld ({t}), a
            xor a
            ld ({t} + 1), a
            jp sp_end
sp_sh:                              ; HL x 2^size
            ld a, (sp_s)
            or a
            ret z
            ld b, a
sp_shl:
            add hl, hl
            djnz sp_shl
            ret
sp_s:       db 0
sp_end:
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
  Spawn = t
End Function

' SetVel i, vx, vy, vz: its speed (a 50th's move)
Public Sub SetVel(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal vx As Integer, ByVal vy As Integer, ByVal vz As Integer)
  ovx(i) = vx : ovy(i) = vy : ovz(i) = vz
End Sub

' SetMover i, mover, flags: what moves it (its state and timer back to 0)
Public Sub SetMover(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal mv As Integer, ByVal flg As Integer)
  omv(i) = mv : oflg(i) = flg : ost(i) = 0 : otm(i) = 0
End Sub

' Hold i, dist, across, up, faster, hold: (MV_HOLD) the station it keeps and how long it holds it
Public Sub Hold(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal dist As Integer, ByVal ax As Integer, ByVal ay As Integer, ByVal fast As Integer, ByVal tm As Integer)
  odist(i) = dist : opa(i) = ax : opb(i) = ay : ospd(i) = fast : otm(i) = tm
End Sub

' Spin i, a, b: it turns by a (about y) and b (about x) 256ths of a turn each picture
Public Sub Spin(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer)
  E3.obj(i * 8 + 4) = (a And 255) + (b And 255) * 256
End Sub

' Mark i, c: its colour on the scanner (Hud3D.Scanner; 0: not shown)
Public Sub Mark(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  E3.obj(i * 8 + 7) = (E3.obj(i * 8 + 7) And 255) + c * 256
End Sub

' Pos i: where it is -> px, py, pz; Move i, x, y, z: put it there
Public Sub Pos(ByVal i As Integer)
  px = E3.obj(i * 8) : py = E3.obj(i * 8 + 1) : pz = E3.obj(i * 8 + 2)
End Sub

Public Sub Move(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer)
  E3.obj(i * 8) = x : E3.obj(i * 8 + 1) = y : E3.obj(i * 8 + 2) = z
End Sub

' OnScreen(i): 1 when it's in the view (as the last Update found it)
Public Function OnScreen(ByVal i As Integer) As Integer
  t = E3.vwz(i)
  OnScreen = 0
  If ocls(i) And t > 100 And t < 30000 Then
    If Abs(E3.vwx(i)) < t And Abs(E3.vwy(i)) * 4 < t * 3 Then OnScreen = 1
  End If
End Function

' Aim i, x, y, z, speed: its speed set toward the point x, y, z, the biggest part of it speed
' (speed under 256)
Public Sub Aim(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal sp As Integer)
  Pos i
  AimAt x - px, y - py, z - pz, sp
  ovx(i) = avx : ovy(i) = avy : ovz(i) = avz
End Sub

' AimAt x, y, z, speed: (avx, avy, avz) along x, y, z, its biggest part speed
Public Sub AimAt(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal sp As Integer)
  Dim m As Integer, q As Integer
  m = Abs(x)
  If Abs(y) > m Then m = Abs(y)
  If Abs(z) > m Then m = Abs(z)
  If m = 0 Then
    avx = 0 : avy = 0 : avz = sp
    Exit Sub
  End If
  q = m \ 120 + 1
  m = m \ q
  If m = 0 Then m = 1
  avx = (x \ q) * sp \ m : avy = (y \ q) * sp \ m : avz = (z \ q) * sp \ m
End Sub

' BoltModel kind, size, dot / DebrisModel kind, size, dot, fall / BlastModel kind, dot: the models
' Fire, Burst and Boom use
Public Sub BoltModel(ByVal kind As Integer, ByVal sc As Integer, ByVal dot As Integer)
  bkind = kind : bsc = sc : bdot = dot
End Sub
Public Sub DebrisModel(ByVal kind As Integer, ByVal sc As Integer, ByVal dot As Integer, ByVal fall As Integer)
  dkind = kind : dsc = sc : ddot = dot : dgrav = fall
End Sub
Public Sub BlastModel(ByVal kind As Integer, ByVal dot As Integer)
  xkind = kind : xdot = dot
End Sub

' FireAt(from, x, y, z, speed): a bolt from object from toward x, y, z (class CL_EBOLT, hitting
' you); Fire(from, speed): at you - or, from -1, from you along your way (class CL_PBOLT, hitting
' the classes in pmask). Its life blife 50ths. The bolt's slot, -1 for none
Public Function FireAt(ByVal from As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal sp As Integer) As Integer
  Pos from
  AimAt x - px, y - py, z - pz, sp
  t = Spawn(bkind, bsc, CL_EBOLT, px + avx * 3, py + avy * 3, pz + avz * 3, bdot)
  FireAt = t
  If t < 0 Then Exit Function
  ovx(t) = avx : ovy(t) = avy : ovz(t) = avz
  omv(t) = MV_STRAIGHT : olife(t) = blife : omask(t) = M_PLAYER
  Spin t, 9, 13
End Function

Public Function Fire(ByVal from As Integer, ByVal sp As Integer) As Integer
  If from >= 0 Then
    Fire = FireAt(from, E3.CamGet(0), E3.CamGet(1), E3.CamGet(2), sp)
    Exit Function
  End If
  avx = (E3.cm(6) \ 128) * sp \ 128 : avy = (E3.cm(7) \ 128) * sp \ 128 : avz = (E3.cm(8) \ 128) * sp \ 128
  t = Spawn(bkind, bsc, CL_PBOLT, E3.CamGet(0) + avx * 2, E3.CamGet(1) + avy * 2 - 60, E3.CamGet(2) + avz * 2, bdot)
  Fire = t
  If t < 0 Then Exit Function
  ovx(t) = avx : ovy(t) = avy : ovz(t) = avz
  omv(t) = MV_STRAIGHT : olife(t) = blife : omask(t) = pmask
End Function

' Burst x, y, z, n: n bits of debris flying off x, y, z (DebrisModel), each living a second or so;
' vx, vy, vz: the speed they share (the thing that blew up's: SetVel's numbers, or 0s)
Public Sub Burst(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal n As Integer, ByVal vx As Integer, ByVal vy As Integer, ByVal vz As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 1 To n
    t = Spawn(dkind, dsc, CL_DEBRIS, x, y, z, ddot)
    If t >= 0 Then
      ovx(t) = vx + Rnd(120) - 60 : ovy(t) = vy + Rnd(120) - 50 : ovz(t) = vz + Rnd(120) - 60
      olife(t) = 30 + Rnd(20) : omv(t) = MV_FALL : opa(t) = dgrav : oflg(t) = dflg   ' <--- CHANGED
      Spin t, 5 + Rnd(8), 7 + Rnd(8)
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' Boom i, size: object i becomes a fireball (BlastModel) of that size, still, for 16 50ths, the
' last 8 a size bigger; it hits nothing
Public Sub Boom(ByVal i As Integer, ByVal sc As Integer)
  ocls(i) = CL_DEBRIS : omask(i) = 0 : omv(i) = MV_BLAST : oflg(i) = 0 : ost(i) = 0
  olife(i) = 16 : ogun(i) = 0 : ovx(i) = 0 : ovy(i) = 0 : ovz(i) = 0
  E3.obj(i * 8 + 5) = xkind + sc * 256
  E3.obj(i * 8 + 6) = 300 * sc
  E3.obj(i * 8 + 7) = xdot
  Spin i, 11, 7
End Sub

' Count(cls): how many objects of class cls there are
Public Function Count(ByVal cls As Integer) As Integer
  Dim n As Integer
  n = 0
  For t = 0 To NOBJ - 1
    If ocls(t) = cls Then n = n + 1
  Next
  Count = n
End Function

' NextEvent(): the next thing that happened in the last Update (EV_FIRE, EV_HIT; its objects in
' ea, eb), 0 when there are no more
Public Function NextEvent() As Integer
  If rdq >= nev Then
    NextEvent = 0
    Exit Function
  End If
  ea = evq(rdq) And 255 : eb = evb(rdq)
  NextEvent = evq(rdq) \ 256
  rdq = rdq + 1
End Function

' Update dt: every object moved on dt 50ths by its mover (lives and guns counted down, flags
' seen to), E3.ViewAll (each one's place in the view), then the hits found: the events queued
Public Sub Update(ByVal dt As Integer)
#asm
            ld a, ({dt})
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_step
            pop iy
            ld ix, ({six})
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
  E3.scene0 = 0 : E3.nobj = NOBJ
  E3.ViewAll
#asm
            ld ({sps}), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld ({six}), ix
            push iy
            call fn_obj3d_lib_o3_hits
            pop iy
            ld ix, ({six})
            ld sp, ({sps})
#endasm
End Sub

' Draw: every object drawn (far to near, as Update last saw them) - after the background
Public Sub Draw()
  E3.scene0 = 0 : E3.nobj = NOBJ
  E3.scache = 1
  E3.Scene
  E3.scache = 0
End Sub

o3_jp:      jp (hl)
os_tab:     dw o3_ret, o3_move, mv_fall, mv_blast, mv_hold, mv_hold, o3_ret, o3_ret, o3_ret, o3_ret, o3_ret   ; <--- NEW ("noflyers": MV_CHARGE .. MV_ORBIT left out)

            inc hl
            ld (hl), b

o3_kill:
            ld hl, {ocls}

            call o3_wrw
            call o3_objp
            ld de, 10
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), 255

o3_zero:
            ld hl, oz_tab

oz_lp:
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            inc hl
            push hl
            ex de, hl
            ld de, (o3_o)

            inc hl

            dw {ovx}, {ovy}, {ovz}, {opa}, {opb}, {ospd}, {odist}, {ohw}, {ohh}, {olz}

            push hl

            ld a, (o3_dt)

            ld d, 0
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l

            push bc

            bit 7, h

            ld a, h

            ld hl, {ovx}

            call mv_1
            ld hl, {ovz}
            ld a, 4
mv_1:
            ld (o3_k), a

            ex de, hl
            ld a, (o3_dt)

            ld hl, 0
mv_m:
            add hl, de
            djnz mv_m
            ex de, hl
            push de
            call o3_objp
            pop de
            ld a, (o3_k)
            ld c, a
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            ld a, (hl)
            add a, e
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            adc a, d

mv_fall:
            call o3_move

            ld a, (o3_dt)

            djnz mf_m

mv_blast:

            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl

            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, c

            add a, a

; ---- the station keepers (MV_HOLD, MV_HOLDONLY), MV_CHARGE, MV_PASS, MV_TURN

            ld hl, (o3_oy)

            rr l
            ld (o3_oy), hl
            ld hl, {otm}

            ld c, l

            add a, a
            add a, a

            rr l
            sra h
            rr l

            ld h, (hl)

            sbc hl, de

fg_2:

            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ld de, (o3_t4)
            add hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l

            call o3_wrw

            inc hl
            ld (o3_cc), hl

; o3_prm: the station keeper's numbers: o3_vm = ospd, o3_dd = odist, o3_ox, o3_oy = opa, opb

fi_s5:

            sbc a, a

            ld d, h
            ld e, l

            add hl, hl
            add hl, de

fi_s4:

            ld l, a

; ---- (NEW) the ground movers and the homer                                  ; <--- NEW (to the @end)

os_land:

            ld de, 8                ; <--- NEW
            add hl, de              ; <--- NEW
            xor a                   ; <--- NEW

            call o3_wrw

            call o3_wrw

; mv_circle: round you at odist (the angle in ost, 8.8 of a 256th, on by ospd a second)

            ld hl, 0
mc_m:
            add hl, de

            add hl, hl
            add hl, de

            ld hl, {ost}
            call o3_rdw
            add hl, de
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            ld hl, {ost}

            ld (mc_c), a

            call o3_s14
            pop bc
            push bc
            call fn_e3_lib_m14

            add hl, de

            ld a, (mc_s)

mc_c:       db 0
; mv_hunt: at you to odist off; now and then back behind its cover (object opb)
mv_hunt:
            ld hl, {otm}
            call o3_tick
            ld (mh_t), a
            ld hl, {ost}
            call o3_rdw
            ld a, l

mh_c1:

            ld de, 1

            ld (o3_tx), hl

            call mh_pt

            or a
            jr z, mh_h1

            call o3_wrw
            ld bc, 0
            ld hl, {ost}
            call o3_wrw
            ld hl, (o3_cam)

            ld (o3_tx + 4), hl

            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l

            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl

            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a

            push hl

            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld e, a

            push hl

            sbc hl, de
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            pop de

mh_t:       db 0
mh_f:       db 0
mh_o:       db 0
; mv_home: in on you, up to opa a 50th each way, turning fast; facing its way

            ld hl, (o3_cam + 2)

            ld h, 0

            add hl, bc

            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a

            sbc hl, de

            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            sra h
            rr l
            ld (o3_t3), hl          ; wanted

ga_1:
            ld hl, (o3_vm)

            call o3_scmp

ga_2:
            ld a, (o3_k)            ; its speed's array
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld bc, o3_vb
            add hl, bc
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld (o3_t2), hl
            call o3_rdw
            ld (o3_t4), hl

            ld a, h

            or a

            jr o3_neg

            bit 7, h

            call o3_absd
            call fa_mx

            ld (hl), d

            inc bc

fc_c:

            push bc

            push bc

            ld b, 0

            ld (hl), d

            inc b
